<pre><code>The fauna of [Mars](318-mars.md) includes all the animals living on the planet Mars, beneath its seas, and on its off-world habitats. Mars has many distinctive indigenous species tailored by humans during the terraforming process. At a distance from the sun 50% greater than the Earth, and only 38% terran gravity, the species inhabiting Mars are noticeably larger than their counterparts on Earth, and adapted for colder average temperatures.

Mars has eleven life zones which are the lower Noachian (desert); Greater Margartifier (temperate lowlands and some coastal lands), Upper Tharsis and Araby (coastal areas and moist northeastern counties); Hesperia (Mediterranean), Hellas and Argyre basins (rolling grasslands and coastal areas), Mariner Valley, and the Elysian, Olympic, and Antarctic Zones, comprising the planet's highest elevations.

# '''Wildlife'''
*Avisaurs- Avisaurs are a lineage of animals unique to Mars, which resemble theropod dinosaurs such as dromaeosaurs and oviraptorids. However, they are actually genetically modified birds, with the genes for such traits as teeth, wing claws, and tail bones (which are present but recessive in all birds) "switched on" to produce a creature similar to their dinosaur ancestors. 
* Porpids--The largest animals on Mars, these are modified descendants of dolphins and other toothed whales which have become baleen whale-like filter-feeders. Instead of baleen, they use their comblike teeth to filter krill and baitfish from the water, much like the crab-eater seal of Earth. The largest species can grow up to 20 meters long and dwell in the deep waters of the Sea of Hellas.
* Martian Dragons-- This is a term used to refer to a variety of modified and usually very large reptiles that have been introduced to the planet at various points. Many were created to resemble mythical creatures such as wyverns or Chinese dragons. So far six of these artificial "species" have been created, and while they are all designated Dragons, very few have any kind of shared common ancestor, though monitor lizards and girdled lizards tend to be the more common sources of genetic code.
* Phoenixes-- Like dragons, this is a catchall term for a number of unrelated but typically large and impressive birds found throughout the planet. So far a total of four species have been created, three of them derived from birds of prey and one from waterfowl.
* Other Modified Species-- Other than the main categories of wildlife on Mars, several other distinct species live here, most either modified from extinct animal DNA, or near exact recreations of actual former Fauna from Earth.

## Noachia
* Desert Phoenix-- This mostly terrestrial raptor was engineered from the terran Secretary Bird and Crane Hawk, and can be found throughout the Noachian and Cimmerian deserts. Standing roughly 1.5 meters tall, the Desert Phoenix survives mainly on insects and small reptiles.
*Woolly Noachian Rhinoceros-- At 7 meters tall, the Noachian Rhino bears a striking resemblance to the ancient ''Paraceratherium'' of Earth, and roams the Noachian plains kicking up soil and depositing feces which provide an essential source of nutrients to the soil, maintaining the southern grasslands. Sporting a thick coat of red fur, the Noachian Rhino is engineered from reconstructed Pleistocene Woolly Rhino DNA.
*Noachian Giant Tortoise-- A modification to Agassiz's desert tortoise has yielded the largest member of the family Testudinidae at 5 meters in length for an adult male, and weighing in at more than 2000 kg. Due to the low gravity, these tortoises walk in a more erect gait than their terran counterparts.

## Margartifer
*Poe-Birds: Modified ravens and crows. Extremely intelligent, at a level rivaling primates. Known to use tools. Frequently scavenge in human cities, feeding on garbage and other waste much as crows on Earth do.
*Griffins: Modified birds of prey with teeth, long tails, and wing claws. Resemble dromaeosaurs such as ''Deinonychus ''or ''Velociraptor.'' Griffins fill the scavenger niche in the Margartifer lowlands. The smallest species, derived from falcons, hunt rodents, while the larger ones, derived from eagles, are capable of killing mammals up to the size of a Scrofanok.
*Martian Bison-- Genetically engineered from strains of North American plains bison and various breeds of domesticated cow, the Martian bison was created to handle the harder winters of Mars while providing a docile and reliable source of beef. At 2 meters tall at the shoulder and another 0.25 meters taller at the large hump on the animal's back, the North American bison weighs in at 700 kg.
*Kestrel Moth-- The second most common pollinating insect on Mars, the Kestrel Moth is a dwarf breed of the Hummingbird hawk-moth of Earth. The species was specifically engineered and introduced to facilitate pollination of Martian produce, and as such its larval stage has been tailored to feed primarily on dead biomass and is repelled by healthy plants. As an adult, the Kestrel moth has a wingspan of only 17mm.
*Common Avisaur-- Commonly known as the House Avi, the Common Avisaur stands 1 meter tall at head height, comes in a variety of color patterns and is a common pet across Mars. In its "natural" environment the Common Avisaur survives primarily by eating small rodents, fish, lizards, and small birds. It traces its origins to the Terran burrowing owl.
*Martian Honey bee. The most common pollinating insect on Mars and not significantly different from its terran counterpart in anatomy. Its only major biological enhancement has been in its pheromone receptors to govern its ability to sense Martian plant-life that its parents species would be unable to recognize.

## Acidalia Basin
*Oxian Drake-- A modification of the Armadillo girdled lizard, and the most common of the dragons. This carnivorous lizard is found in the planet's warmer equatorial regions and grows up to 5 meters long. They actively prey on any smaller animal they can kill, but as with all large Martian predators they have been engineered to instinctively avoid humans.
*Towerbirds: Modified geese. The largest Avisaurs, standing up to 4.5 meters tall and weighing up to a tonne. Wings are vestigial and tipped with long, rake-like claws, much like the extinct therizinosaurs. These claws are used to gather branches of trees to eat, as well as for display in males.
* Martian Lynx--The largest purely land-based predator on Mars, a modified, much larger (about the size of a tiger) descendant of the bobcat which feeds on other mammals, birds, and Avisaurs. They were engineered to dislike the odor of humans, as with all large predators on Mars, so unprovoked attacks on humans are nonexistent.

## Amazonis Basin
* Great Phoenix-- Sporting a 9 meter wingspan, and iridescent red, orange, and yellow plumage, the Great Phoenix is considered one of the most beautiful birds on Mars. Unlike the other three species of Phoenix the Great Phoenix is not a raptor, but rather a species of waterfowl descended from various species of Swan, Mandarin duck and the Ruddy shelduck. Surviving mainly on small fish and weeds, the Great Phoenix dwells in rivers and lakes across the regions bordering the Amazon Sea, migrating from the northern islands of Elysium to southeastern Araby in the summer and then back down to the Amazonis basin in the winter.
*Winged Lemur - Modified from the terran flying fox and dwarf lemur, the winged lemur was one of the first organisms engineered using DNA from two separate species. Unlike a flying fox, the winged lemur is not considered a true flying mammal as it is only capable of extended gliding on its realtively short 1.1 meter wingspan.
* Shen Long- Another aquatic dragon, this one derived from the earless monitor lizard ''Lanthanotus borneensis ''of Borneo. Growing up to 6 meters long, they resemble the archetypal Chinese dragon, and are aquatic fish-eaters which detect prey (mostly bottom-dwelling fish and mollusks) with their sensitive barbels.
*Hogparrots: Modified parrots with hands and long tails, which resemble the prehistoric ''Oviraptor''. Intelligent and omnivorous, often kept as pets. Can be trained to imitate human speech. Their size is variable, with the smallest varieties (derived from budgerigars) being small enough to perch in a human hand and the largest (derived from macaws) standing up to three feet tall. Unlike other avisaurs, they still lack teeth.
*Dawn Avisaur-- A genetic descendent of the Carolina parakeet and a scavenger of forest floor fruits and nuts, Dawn Avis are a less common, but still popular pet on Mars.
*Atlas Sloth Lemur: A very large descendant of ''Palaeopropithecus'' that were brought to Mars during the terraforming process and as a result from spending some time on the formerly red planet, they've grown to a size comparable to ''Gigantopithecus blacki'', the largest terrestrial ape that has ever lived. Much like their smaller ancestors, Atlas Sloth Lemurs are folivores, which means that they eat mostly leaves, but will eat some fruit, and occasionally seeds, if they ever find them.

## Hesperia
* Magnificent Windrider-- The largest flying creature on Mars, with a 15-meter wingspan (though at 200 kg its weight is much smaller than the largest dragons), these enormous white birds are modified from Earth's cranes. They are herbivores, feeding on grasses and seeds, and undertake annual high-altitude migrations halfway around the planet to their breeding grounds in Hesperia. Their calls are something not soon forgotten: a majestic trumpeting cry that echoes for miles.
* Yellow Wyvern- The result of heavy modifications to the genes of the Sulawesi lined gliding lizard, Yellow Wyvern's are named for their distinct yellow wings and serve as the apex predator in the greater Syritis region. With a 9-meter wingspan it is the largest flying dragon outside of the Olympics.
*Azure Porpid-- One of the smallest species of porpids at 3 meters in length, and sporting a bright blue hide on its back, the Azur porpid cruises the warm waters of the Hesperian Gulf during the winter and migrates to Isidis bay in the summer. It is modified from the Dusky Dolphin
*Hesperian Seahawk-- Despite its name, this predatory bird is not a true hawk, but a descendent of the Antarctic skua. Unlike their ancestors, they lack webbing on their feet and have enlarged claws for dispatching their prey. They also scavenge a great deal, eating dead animals along the coastlines.

## Elysium
* Elysian Serpent- The most docile of the Dragons, and the only species derived from snakes rather than lizards. They live in the river valleys of Elysium and live on a diet of mostly fish and small birds and mammals. They are derived from pythons, namely the reticulated python of Asia and the amethyst python of Australia.
*Red Elk-- Actually a large species of antelope, and the result of genetically modified Impala, the Red Elk is one of the largest land mammals on Mars, standing roughly 2 meters at shoulder height. and more than 3 meters tall at the top of the head (not counting the horns, which make males seem even larger still).
*Fenghuang-- The Elysian variety of Phoenix survives primarily on insects and worms in the damp forest floors of Elysium. Genetically derived from the Golden pheasant and Java peafowl, this bird is only a meter in length before including its tail plumage, and are often kept as pets.

## Mariner Valley and East Tharsis
* Aurora sea eagle-- <span>The second largest bird on Mars, </span>derived from the Steller's sea eagle of Earth, and feeds mainly on fish and other birds. Its wingspan reaches up to 8.5 meters--far larger than the 2.7 meters or so reached by its unmodified ancestor, but still small compared to the largest dragons and windriders.
* Great Golden Eagle-- Derived from the Golden eagle, these immense raptors nest in caves a ledges along Mariner Valley and can grow to a wing-span of 8 meters. They are both predators and scavengers, hunting mammals such as Scrofanoks and birds such as Windriders.
* Common Phoenix-- This average sized raptor is derived from the Red Tailed Hawk and can be found in forests, mountains, and cities all over Mars mostly feeding on rodents and smaller birds. These birds sport a wingspan of 1.5 meters and bright Red-orange and golden plumage.
* Mariner Wyvern- Approximately 5-meters in length, this species was one of the later predators introduced into the Martian biosphere. Modified primarily from the gliding lizard ''Draco volans'', the Mariner Wyverns feature a set of wings created from the fusion of forelimbs and the abdominal patagium, permitting powered flight.
* Scrofanok-- A type of slender, deer-like wild boar that has been modified to cope with the thin air and scarce vegetation of the Martian highlands. One of the most common large mammals on the planet, so much so that they are hunted for sport in limited numbers.
* Sunmantle Butterfly- One of Mars's most iconic insects, derived from the sunbeam butterfly of Earth. Sporting a wingspan of nearly 10 cm, with gold, black, and orange markings, they are powerful flyers and efficient gliders, making them ideal for the steep canyons of Mariner Valley. Their bright orange caterpillars, which can grow up to 8 cm long, feed on the leaves of trees such as black maple and Arean poplar.
*Dire Wolf-- Not to be confused with the fictional Dire Wolves in George R. R. Martin's ''Game of Thrones '' novels, these are descendants of an de-extinct species from Earth. Due to Mars' low gravity in comparison to Earth, Dire Wolves have been known to grow to the size of a Black Bear, though they are not as massive. 
*Martian Unicorn-- A genetic chimera of horses and rhinoceroses, with a horn made out of keratin. The species has no natural predators, but a mare only produces one foal every two years, keeping the population in check. Unicorns were created to serve an essential roll in distributing concentrated amounts of normally toxic compounds extracted from the Martian lithosphere or deposited in air drops over forests and fields. Unicorns are the only species designed to actively seek out these compounds and consume them, using their digestive system to deposit the raw compounds as droppings that can more easily reach the wider biosphere. However, this process has become less essential in recent years, and the species is expected to go extinct in less than a century without genetic intervention.

## Australe Plateau and Tharsis Bulge
* Olympic Razorback - Often considered the most impressive of the Martain dragons due to the combination of their large size (in fact, with a wingspan of up to 13 meters it is the largest of the dragons) and the jagged black scales on their backs. Like the Oxai Drake they're modified largely from Armadillo girdled lizards. They are noted for their their ability to spit a highly acidic venom over 4 meters in self-defense, an ability dubbed "fire-breathing" due to the burning sensation it causes. They are surprisingly lightweight, weighing only about 400 kg--a necessity for flight at such a large size, even in low Martian gravity.
* Martian Jackalope - A modification of the antelope jackrabbit, with the addition of short, sharp "horns" atop its head, above its eyes. A small herbivore that feeds primarily on low-growing vegetation and a frequent prey animal for larger carnivores.

## Hellas
*Giant Hellenic Octopus-- A variation on the giant Pacific octopus (''Enteroctopus dofleini'') of Earth, the Hellenic variety reaches 10 meters in length (and up to 20 meters in diameter) and rivals Porpids for intelligence. Unlike terran octopuses, they are capable of breeding more than once, and hence can live for several decades, allowing them to reach great sizes.
[thumb|Giant Spotted Porpid](2071-file-giant-spotted-porpid-png.md)
* Giant Spotted Porpid-- At 20 meters in length, the Giant Porpid is the largest animal on Mars, living in the deep waters of the Hellenic Sea and surviving on krill that feed on the sea's great algae blooms. It is descended from the Atlantic Spotted Dolphin.

*Hellenic eagle-ray-- Measuring up to 9 meters across, this is the second-largest fish on Mars after the Isonade. It is a variant of the Spotted eagle-ray of Earth, and like its relative, it preys actively on bottom-crawling mollusks. Like all eagle-rays, it possesses a venomous spine at the base of its tail, but is harmless to humans--in fact, divers often swim with them.

## Boreal Ocean
*[thumb|Harbor Porpid](2070-file-harbor-porpid-png.md) Harbour porpid-- Modified from the Harbour porpoise of Earth, the Harbour porpid is 5 meters long and feeds on plankton common to the northern coasts of Tharsis and Araby which were engineered to control the population of water cleaning algae.
*[thumb|White Porpid](2072-file-white-porpid-png.md) White porpid-- Modified from the common dolphin and at 10 meters in length, the White porpid roams near the Martian north pole feeding on krill in the Great Black Reef.
*Martian isopod-- Modiifed from Giant isopod and common lobster DNA, the Martian isopod survives on Porpid falls and other bio-debris near the bottom of the Boreal Ocean. They are considered a delicacy on Earth, and were a cheap source of protein on Mars during early terraforming.
*Great Boreal Salmon -- Modified Terran silver salmon that can grow up to 2 meters long, known for its nearly black back and silver body. It is a staple protein for much of Mars.
*[thumb|Isonade](2073-file-isonade-png.md) Isonade-- A very large shark modified from the Snaggletooth shark. They were named after a shark-like sea monster from Japanese mythology, and can grow up to 9 meters long. As the top predators in Mars's oceans, they will even prey on juvenile Porpids.
*Wani: A genetic descendent of the Saltwater Crocodile. They're named after a type of dragon found in Japanese Mythology and can grow to 8 meters in length, which makes them a challenge for adult Isonade, as they are both comparable in size to each other. Despite this, they normally feed on smaller porpids, Boreal Salmon, coelacanths, sea birds, and juvenile Martian Sea Cows. They are fully marine, only coming ashore to lay eggs.
*Martian Sea Cow: Modified from Stellar's Sea Cows, and at a size comparable to White Porpids, these giant grazers roam near Northern Tempe, feeding on sea kelp, and other marine plant-life.


# Plant Life
*Martian Thistle: One of the first macro-scale plants introduced to the surface. The Martian Thistle, AKA the Martian Tumbleweed, was one of the most successful terraforming organisms ever created, using a common terran tumbleweed as its base to spread and propagate itself across the surface. This plant was developed primarily to improve soil health and was extremely adaptable to the Martian climate.
* Ironwood - With an average height of 100 meters and an estimated maximum height of 300 tons, the Martian Sequoia, better known as the Ironwood Tree, was engineered to serve as a wind breaking forests along rivers and glacial reservoirs. Their name comes from their ability to absorb the iron rich soil of Mars into its flesh and bark, the effect of which is an extremely sturdy conifer that can grow to tremendous heights under low gravity.
*Black Maple - A special variant on the Japanese maple tree, the Black Maple is named for its extremely dark leafs which serve to compensate for the lack of Martian sunlight and guard against radiation.
*Arean Poplar - With the exception of its height, the Arean Poplar is nearly identical to its terran cousin. Created to serve as a faster growing, low mass alternative to the Ironwoods, Poplars line high embankments, rivers and lakes across the Martian equator, protecting terrain from wind damage.
*Red Cactus - An unintended consequence of this variant of the cousin of the Pitaya was a distinctly red skin. Its fruit, a tangier, somewhat less seedy version of the Terran Dragon Fruit, is a favorite treat among the local populace. Red Cacti are common across the deserts of Noachis, and is cultivated for mass consumption.
*Longan - A variant of the terran tree of the same name, Longans were cultivated by Chinese settlers in the 2080s.
*Blood Apple - An engineered variant of the Terran Fuji Apple, the blood apple is named for its deep red skin.
*Fire pear - A strain of Asian pear with an inserted gene to boost production of cinnamaldehyde, the fruit of this tree is both sweet, refreshing, and spicy. Like most fruit trees on Mars, its trees are extremely broad and darker than its terran counterparts.
*Red Wheat - Cultivated from various strains of Earth grains, Red Wheat shifts to a dusty red when its ready to be harvested. The effect tends to be bleached out by most mills.
*Giant sundew- A carnivorous plant growing up to six feet tall, with sticky leaves that trap and digest insects and small vertebrates such as rodents and songbirds. Found primarily in the equatorial lowlands.
*Nightweed - Strain of common edible seaweed bred to grow hundreds of meters in length in the deeper waters of the Boreal Ocean. By day it is responsible for a sizable amount of black body radiation, but by night it plays host to a bio-luminescent light show due to the bacteria that inhabit it.
*Mediplants - First produced at Bradbury Base, Mediplants were once the dominant plant life on Mars. Engineered to produce biomedical compounds in huge quantities on the pre-terraformed surface of Mars, these plants created the economic incentive that ultimately led to Martian terraforming and long term colonization.

## Pioneer Organisms
This list includes all surviving pioneer plants on Mars used in the early days of terraforming to build humus, increase the surface temperature, and mine the pre-terraformed soil for valuable chemicals for either soil or atmospheric improvements. All of the Martian pioneer organisms are halophytic extremophytes, defined by jet black skin, and a high tolerance to low air pressure and cold temperatures. All were engineered to grow, spread, and die quickly to build up humus on the surface.

*Black Sea Pickle - A nearly extinct pioneer organism that once hugged the early and expanding coasts of what would become the boreal ocean. Black Sea Pickle shares its genetic lineage with all other forms of Salicornia that are quite common on Mars to this day.
*Drywater Cress - One of the first terraforming organisms intorduced to what would become the Boreal Ocean, this modified species of Thellungiella salsugineum was often used as a source for genetic code for other pioneer plants, due to its ability to recover and grow after being frozen solid.
*Basalt Cactus - One of the first large organisms introduced to Mars, the Basalt Cactus is modified from the lava cactus endemic to the Galápagos Islands.
*Black Saxifraga - A modified relative of its purple terran counterpart, Black Saxifraga was originally found all over the Martian lowlands during the beginning of terraforming, but now can only be found on the slopes of the Tharsian mountains, and across the southern polar regions.
*Martian Eremogone - Derived from Eremogone bryophylla, this plant was more successful as a genetic source organism for other pioneer plants, than it was on its own, and is now only found in the Tharsian mountains.

'''Equoloii '''or '''Equos '''''(Cognohippops manipulator)'' are the intelligent inhabitants of the planet [Equoloa](2630-equoloa.md), fourth planet orbiting the star Kepler-18. They are bipedal, vaguely mammal-like creatures with a thin layer of fur known for a wide variety of colors and patterns that coats most of their back, shoulders, neck and chest, and possess a unique sensory system allowing for a degree of non-verbal communication.

# Description
The Equoloii are bipedal species with an erect posture and locomotion similar to that of terran birds with large two toed feet providing digitigrade locomotion. Their digitigrade bipedalism is assisted by a tail to help provide balance. The Equoloii head features a nasal bone that extends up to the top of the head and arcs back tapering near the back of the parietal bone with the actual nostrils positioned at either side of this cranial ridge. The Maxilla forms a single smooth surface for the "muzzle" and the face is framed by large jaw muscles and ear slits resting above the upper jaw muscle. Their somewhat pointed ears are generally rested in a backwards position. Their teeth are mostly flat for grinding vegetation, however they have one set of small teeth capable of tearing meat, suggesting an omnivorous diet was a fairly recent evolutionary development. 

Their hands feature three fingers and a single thumb. The Equoloii, like the other species on their planet, have a heightened sense of electromagnetism (similar to that of sharks and platypuses) thanks to two small sacks of biomass similar to ampullae of Lorenzini on either side of their heads. These organs give the Equoloii a kind of extrasensory perception of other organisms and the emotional and physical states of other members of their species. This often serves as a form of unique 'body language', especially when alerting for danger via heightened activity. The Equoloii are also a sexually dimorphic species, with the female standing at 1.7 meter in height while the male stands at 1.8.

# Evolution
As with many forms of alien life that bear a passing resemblance to Earth life, the Equoloii have a very different evolutionary history from their Earth counterparts. The ancestors of terrestrial "vertebrates" on Equoloa were aquatic creatures vaguely resembling very large tardigrades, with several pairs of stubby legs and chewing mouthparts. The electroreception organs of these creatures, which have been retained in their land-dwelling descendant, are thought to have originally evolved as a way to detect prey in murky water. By about 300 million years ago, the descendants of these land pioneers had established a standard body plan for Equoloa's land vertebrates, with the number of limbs decreased to four and a hydrocarbon-based skeleton. One of the most successful lineages of these "vertebrates" was one that developed a type of endothermy, allowing them to dominate the herbivore and predator niches on the planet. The Equoloii are descended from a subset of this lineage that filled a niche broadly equivalent to that of ground-dwelling apes on Earth. Adapting from an herbivorous diet to an omnivorous one allowed for a larger brain, and this quickly led to sapience.

The recent evolutionary trait of having one set of small sharp teeth capable of tearing meat has led to debates on whether they may have evolved from prey species to a scavenger one.

# Society and Structure
# History
## '''Ancient History'''
Recorded history of early Equoloii civilizations that isn't related to clear mythology can be dated back to ten thousand terran years ago. As several major tribes became dominant in the continents of Equoloa. Warring tribes were eventually evolved into warring imperial systems over the course of thousands of years. With most of recent Equoloii periods being divided between each dominant empire.

Throughout Equoloii history, there has been a total of roughly eighty-six empires but only twenty-six were recorded as a major period. Each period had brought some sort of golden age of culture and technological advancement.

Local histories record the greatest of these empires as having arisen around 6,600 Terran years ago with the discovery of six naturally occurring nuclear fission sources in an underground reservoir stretching over Aruoqis Empire's badlands. After two local polymaths collaborated to control the flow of steam from these naturally occurring reactors, creating primitive power plants. These two polymaths, commissioned by the emperor to find a way to increase the production of lumber products while they faced war with their neighbor, used the plants to create a series of primitive sawmills which doubled the output of shipyards and tradesmen, and is believed to have been a deciding factor during the Aruoqis first great war.

The power plants gave the Aruoqis a massive technological leg-up, and whole towns were built by order of the emperor around the power plants to produce more wood, ships, textiles, and other manufactured goods when most civilizations were just reaching their age of sail. Aruoquis Imperial military forces grew to conquer more territory than any empire in the planet's history, and an Industrial Age of Enlightenment came to dominate Aruoquis culture.

Aruoqis expansion was met with resistance from the lesser empires, but given their high productivity from both a pre-modern industrial base and land acquisitions, there was simply no single power capable of challenging them. The Aruoqis decision to relocate their capital and imperial court to the growing communities near the nuclear plants would prove to be the empire's downfall, as continued exploitation of the power source and surrounding groundwater led to increased radiation sickness and cancer rates in both the civilian population and the nobility. Despite generations of scholars exploring the "Capital sickness" as it was known, the cause was never identified, however historians and political sociologists across known space have attributed that to political corruption/suppression of information. After 1400 years the rate of illness in the capital had become so severe that power had functionally devolved to healthier, but officially less powerful noble families in more far flung regions. This devolution would persist until an earthquake in the 3rd Millenia BCE caused the release of radioactive fallout that covered the land and vented most of the water that naturally regulated the reactor, leading to its shutdown. The fallout blighted irrigated land and led to generations of disease from those effected. The collapse of the Aruoqis Empire and creation of such a large exclusion zone created the longest dark age in the planet's history.

## '''First Contact'''
First Contact was made with the Terrans on October 10, 2135 when the contact team of the ISV-18 Opportunity was given the go-order to land following a year long crewed survey from orbit. The team, led by Captain Ben Ckre-Li, first interacted with inhabitants of the Gliaceis Empire. Despite initial caution, both sides warmed to each other through first contact protocols. The greatest hinderance to early Human-Equoloii relations was the Equoloii's near universal suspicion of industrial machines and high energy power plants, a cultural remnant from the disaster that befell the Aruoqis. Efforts were instead focused on providing medical aid to a planet that had an atypical number of genetic diseases and birth defects, despite most of the population avoiding the Aruoqis Exclusion Zone for millennia. This medical aid endeared humanity to the Gliaceis and wider Equoloii societies, and eased the introduction of other technolgoies.

By the 2150s the Second Equoloii Industrial Age had begun, although the willingness to adopt anything other than wind, solar, and hydroelectric power hindered progress. While humans had few objections to the Equoloii demand that no nuclear or combustion-based power source be used on their world, the refusal of the Equoloii to adopt geothermal power sources has been a contentious issue between the two species, especially after most Equoloii were educated to the difference between geothermal energy and natural nuclear reactors. This has created a reliance and defacto trade relationship between Equoloii societies and humans aboard the star system's [Beachhead Orbital](1477-orbitals.md), which in turn has caused political tensions on Earth over supposed "human colonization of the Equoloii."

In the 2150s, there was a movement for Gliaceis and surrounding Empires to join the United States as Free Associations. However, by the 2160s, the movement largely declined due to the rise of fear of expansion amongst the other Equoloii, that the Gliaceis expansion would be a repeat of that of the Aruoqis Empire, a common cultural allegory meant to caution against disasater. However, the first scholars and immigrants of the Equoloii were sent to the Sol System to learn more about human customs over a decade earlier.

docs.text: Not to be rude in the least, but I don't think the inclusion of force-weilding wingged anthropomorphic ponies is really within the realm of McKnight's Second Renaissance. I think at least that the handwavium psuedo-Force is outside the non-fiction realism that's purveyed elsewhere in the Wikia.

>ponies .... well Ok

Well the universe can hold many possibilities and the more we explore it, there is bound to  be some things previously thought to be work only in fiction. Just trying to be unique here. If he removes the so called "pseudo-force" part then that is fine and is up to him.

I just thought that there should be something unique or different that powers another species that humans didn't already normally replicate. Like I read in other pages that other aliens used stuff like their equivalent to atomic power, something humans already have.

But I'll gonna keep snipping parts of this page anyways (starting with the anthropomorphic part)



I think I recall humans being able to do stuff similar but with<span style="font-size:13px;"> the use of technology. But i did imply that this stuff was enabled from genetic (or minor tech) modification, which is in the realm of possibility</span>

The '''Volmarro''' (''Arthropelta cranitus'') are the intelligent inhabitants of the moon Volorum orbiting the Supermassive planet Locno, itself orbiting HD 197027. They are bipedal, with a partially armored dermis with a distinct tangerine pigment range.

# Evolution
The dominant clade of land "vertebrates" is a clade of low, squat, heavily armored creatures, which in turn evolved from aquatic ancestors vaguely resembling Earth's long-extinct placoderms. Their armor evolved not for protection from predators, but for protection the cold and desiccation on the world's surface, along with the more intense radiation of the K-type stars of the 61 Cygni system. Humanlike intelligence did not evolve as easily in such circumstances as it did on more temperate world's such as Earth, a large brain being an inefficient use of resources in times of scarcity. The ancestors of the Volmarro, therefore, achieved intelligence through a slightly different route than those of humanity. They were direct descendants of a clade of vaguely sloth-like herbivores that were forced to become ground-dwelling omnivores when Volorum's forests largely disappeared.

# Description
The Volmarro exhibit an extreme form of sexual dimorphism. Females stand upwards of 2.5 meters tall compared to the males which are only 1.7 meters tall. Males have a slick leathery dermis, compared to females who are covered in a a layer of dermal bone comparable to those of terran armadillos. Traits common to the species are eyes wide facing eyes, a common sinus cavity in which the tear ducts extend to include a simple scent receptor, and a dark beak like mouth partially covered by flexible flaps of skin that enable a wider range of consonants. They sport two sets of ears one larger set above a smaller set at the side of the head, giving them extremely detailed hearing capabilities comparable to certain varieties of terran owls. Their eyes see deeper into the Infared spectrum and less into the Ultraviolet than natural humans. Their skulls sport a Sagittal crest similar to early man, though it is far more pronounced on the males than the females.

# History
Volorum is a particularly dry moon with only 22% of its surface is covered with liquid in the form of two large equatorial seas and the largest sea mostly covered with Ice near the planet's south Pole. The North Pole features a smaller ice cap, rounding out the planet's 24% surface coverage in ice. Smaller lakes and rivers dot the planet, but on the whole Volorum is extremely dry and cold world compared to Earth. As such Volmarro civilization did not see nearly so extreme examples of geographic isolation as early humanity, and a common culture and global trade network emerged by the 7th century BCE when civilization was still in the late Bronze Age. Volorum has observed three civilization collapses comparable to the Bronze Age Collapse and the medieval era of Europe. All three are believed to be the result of stellar flare activity from one of the two stars in the system which lead to mass death on the surface. Contemporary Volmarro civilization emerged in 1277 CE (Earth standard calendar) and first contact was made in 2125 CE.

## '''Early civilization'''
Early Volmarro civilization emerged around 13000 BCE around the mouth of the Roklee river near the coast of the Lro'Lrik Sea. This early culture actually was not the result of land-based agriculture but fishing and eventually seafood farms. Agriculture would not emerge until the rise of the Kla'mo civilization in the Great Valley of Kla'mo in 11000 BCE. This civilization began cultivating carbohydrate rich thin tubers which could be densely planted together and stored for long periods between harvests. The Kla'mo would come to conquer a significant portion of territory and rival the Lro'Lrik civilizations.

## '''First medieval period'''
Around 10500 BCE HD 197027 experienced heavy flare activity that reduced the planet's population by between 50 and 80%. The die off impacted several ancient dynasties and led to the collapse of most of the planet's major civilizations. A period of warring tribes and eventually feudalistic kingdoms emerged which were themselves eventually consolidated under four large empires by 8200 BCE.

## '''Second medieval period'''
The Four Empires eventually reached a level of technological and social development comparable with with the Victorian ear on Earth, with early steam engines, and some evidence of powered flight being achieved by 7000 BCE, however around that same point in time, a second collapse occurred when HD 197027 began to experience increased flare activity. It is believed no more than 50% of all life on the planet was killed as a result, The resulting dark age only lasted until 6100 BCE, and eventually the planet was unified under a single empire by 5000 BCE. A degree of technological stagnation, but stable social orders emerged during this period, and while the empire never grew beyond early industrial technology, the planet only saw 5 confirmed rebellions and wars during the 3200 years of the Empire's rule over Volorum.

## '''Third medieval period'''
In 1800 BCE Volorum experienced its worst period of flare activity in its history with the planet being struck by extreme flare activity from HD 197027, and 600 years later the planet being struck again by flares from HD 197027. In this 600 year window, the planet's population fell by 89%. Civilization was set back completely after centuries of unrest, wars, and religious purges.

## '''Contemporary civilization'''
By approximately 2000 CE Volorum's population had reached the iron age once again, and planetary communications had resumed. At the time of first contact, the most advanced Volmarro societies had rediscovered the lateen sail and gunpowder.

## '''First Contact'''
First contact between humans and Volmarro began on May 3, 2125 when the ISV-09 Explorer's crew made planetfall near the planet's most developed city, Volga Ka. The initial contact proved to be peaceful, but quite confusing for the Volmarro who could not comprehend human gender dynamics from the perspective of a rigidly matriarchal society. The notion of humanity's less sexually dimorphic, post gender society was seen as a curiosity to the Volmarro females, and a was very attractive to the Volmarrow males. The notion of males attending higher education was utterly alien to their society. Thus it nearly caused an interstellar incident when First Contact protocol was explained to the planet's political leadership.

In the 35 years since first contact the Volmarro has undergone a prolonged period of social and political upheaval, kept from reaching a point of utter chaos by the introduction of human technologies that have radically improved the quality of life for much of their people.

While Volmarro society still finds human egalitarianism strange and alien to their customs, some progress has been made to grant more rights to males and members of their society who do not identify with the sex they were born with. Males were permitted full education privileges after First Contact, and voting rights were awarded in 2153 after the planet was politically unified. While humans and Volmarro maintain peaceful relations, there is no serious movement for the Volmarro to join the American protectorate as a Free Association.

This template adds an inline bar graph to tables with numeric (including negative) values that a reader may wish to compare.

Use this template inside a table. The template generates either two table cells (for cases in which all values are positive) or three (to accommodate negative bars going off to the left). Thus, your table headers should have '''colspan="2"''' or '''colspan="3"''' (or similar combinations), respectively, to correctly span the columns.

The template generates two cells if the ''scale'' parameter is positive and three if it is negative.

# Usage
 <nowiki>{{</nowiki>bartable|''value''|''unit''|''scale''|''height''|''style''<nowiki>}}</nowiki>

; ''value'' (mandatory) : any real number or math expression that evaluates to a number. Commas can be used to [group digits](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Digit_grouping). See [Help:Calculation](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Help:Calculation) for the syntax for math expressions.
; ''unit'' (default = empty string) : the unit, e.g. "m" for metres. Prepend a space if you want a space between the value and the unit. If ''unit'' starts with "''/''", the value is converted between units (using the '''[convert](209-template-convert.md)''' template) as follows:
:: "''/unit1/unit2/round''" converts the value from ''unit1'' to ''unit2'' and rounds it to ''round'' decimal places (using <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>convert|''value''|''unit1''|''unit2''|''round''|abbr=on<nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>). Unfortunately ''unit1'', ''unit2'' or ''round'' cannot contain a "''/''" or a "=" — if anyone knows how to allow it (or translate other characters to it), please help.
; ''scale'' (default = 1) : a factor multiplied by ''value'' to give the width of the bar in pixels. Use the same scale in every row, as otherwise the bar chart won’t be to scale!
: ''scale'' can be negative, in which case an additional column (for showing negative values) is created. See [[#3-column (positive and negative values)|example below]].
; ''height'' (default = "2ex") : the height of the bar as a [CSS](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/cascading_style_sheet) measurement e.g. "1em" or "16px".
; ''style'' (default = empty string) : a CSS style string to apply to the bar, e.g. "background:red;".

# Examples
{{for|pages using this template|Special:WhatLinksHere/Template:Bartable}}

## Real-world example
<pre>
{| class="wikitable"
|+ Melting point at 1 atmosphere
! Substance  !! Temperature !! colspan="2" | Relative size
|-
| Mercury    || {{bartable| -38.72|/C/F|-2|1em|background:silver}}
|-
| Bromine    || {{bartable|  -7.10|/C/F|-2|1em|background:brown}}
|-
| Water      || {{bartable|      0|/C/F|-2|1em}}
|-
| Phosphorus || {{bartable|  44.10|/C/F|-2|1em|background:red}}
|-
| Iodine     || {{bartable| 113.50|/C/F|-2|1em|background:indigo}}
|-
| Sulphur    || {{bartable| 115.36|/C/F|-2|1em|background:yellow}}
|}
</pre>

The '''Hivvir''' are one of two intelligent inhabitants of the planet Ivrilu in the Kepler-452 system, the other being the [Hiilo](2103-hiilo.md). The Hivvir are natural gliders, with winglike lateral extensions of skin called patagia that allow them to soar great distances in the low gravity, higher pressure atmosphere of Ivrilu.

# Evolution
Ivrilu has a surface gravity only 63% that of Earth, and 125% the atmospheric pressure, enabling far more avenues for evolution to enable powered flight. The Hivvir's distant ancestors--and the common ancestors of all "vertebrates" on Ivrilu-- were six limbed amphibious cephalopods featuring gliding membranes. Later descendants of these ancestors evolved a more tetrapod-esque body plan, with two of the limbs becoming vestigial, but the membranes remained.  

The Hivvir, like the Hillo are bipedal, standing roughly 1.9 meters tall and are noticeably more slender than humans, with no hair or other integument to speak of. They posses eyesight far superior to natural humans, with eyes that can move independently of each other and possess seven color receptors compared to human's natural three. 

# History
## Society
The Hivvir are organized into interconnected tree or cliff dwelling family groups. These troops are capable of using stone hand tools, and express their history and culture through wood carving and cave art, but no troops have been found with a written language. It has also been observed that the Hivvir have a far more rudimentary spoken language than their Hiilo cousins, attributed to smaller brain cavities.

## '''First Contact'''
At the time of First Contact, the Hivvir and Hiilo had fairly limited contact with one another, with the Hivvir proving to be the more difficult of the two species to communicate with. Efforts to give the Hivvir access to terran education have been extremely difficult, with some scientists suggesting that the only way the Hivvir will ever achieve any kind of written civilization will be if they're [artificially uplifted.](3635-uplifted-animals.md)

The '''Hiilo''' are one of two intelligent inhabitants of the planet Ivrilu in the Kepler-452 system, the other being the [Hivvir](2101-hivvir.md). The Hiilo split off from their Hivvir ancestors around 700k years ago. Unlike their cousins, the Hiilo are not able to glide, and instead dwell primarily in temperate savannas.

# Evolution
Ivrilu has a surface gravity only 63% that of Earth, and 125% the atmospheric pressure, enabling far more avenues for evolution to enable powered flight. The Hivvir's distant ancestors--and the common ancestors of all "vertebrates" on Ivrilu-- were six limbed amphibious cephalopods featuring gliding membranes. Later descendants of these ancestors evolved a more tetrapod-esque body plan, with two of the limbs becoming vestigial, but the membranes remained.  

The Hiilo, like the Hivvir are bipedal, standing roughly 2.2 meters tall and are noticeably more slender than humans, with no hair or other integument to speak of. Their eyesight is superior to natural humans, but inferior to that of the Hivvir, with eyes that can move independently of each other and possess seven color receptors compared to human's natural three. Their patagia is far less developed than the Hivvir, making it impossible for them to achieve any form of flight beyond reducing their rate of fall.

# History
## Society
The Hiilo were organized into several largely pastoral tribes prior to first contact, almost entirely dwelling within a large valley in the temperate south of the planet's largest continental mass. At the time of first contact, it was estimated that there were around 18,000 individuals at time of first contact, compared to the 70,000 of the Hivvir.

## '''First Contact'''
The Hiilo have been fairly receptive to human education and technology transfer, having crafted their own written language by 2125, and adopting many terran agricultural practices. This has led to a population boom, and the elevation of the Hiilo to the dominant species on the planet.

# History

## '''Military service'''
## '''Captain of the ''Constitution'''''
Kaplan's service during [World War III](107-world-war-iii.md) placed him in the running for the captain's chair of the ISV-01 ''Enterprise'', and many believed he was passed over for Jin Musgrave because [NASA](1592-nasa.md) wanted a civilian to be the first person to make First Contact, and Musgrave was an accomplished scientist as well as a commander of spacecraft.

## '''Actions on Tu'''
### '''Squirrel Wars'''
### '''Return to Earth and Investigation'''
Kaplan was severely reprimanded for his actions on Tu by NASA, but avoided court-marshal by the Space Force and was given a desk job at NASA Armstrong Space Center. In his autobiography, ''Contact: An Account of the First Interstellar War'' Kaplan defended his actions, but admitted that he felt the only reason he was not stripped of his rank and forced to resign in disgrace was because of the testimony of Commander Musgrave during the hearings.
