The '''Battle of Washington''', also known as the Siege of Washington, was an attempt to capture the American capital by Mexican and Mexican-allied forces during the [Third Mexican-American War](119-third-mexican-american-war.md). It is the only time since the War of 1812 that a foreign power has attempted to capture and occupy Washington D.C. 

On August 11th, 2136, Halvidar nationalized the Planetary Guards of the colonies and called them to defend the Homeland in what would become Operation Stardust.  Mexico detected the fleet on August 24th, and on August 27th the colonial forces would reach Earth. Every simulation assured Mexico's leadership that the colonial fleet's forces would overwhelm them in short order, leaving Mexican war planners to prepare for the worst. Hoping to end the war before the first wave of the fleet arrived, Mexico launched a daring attack of its own on the US capitol of Washington D.C., detonating a nuclear flare above the city and invading in force on August 26th. 

President Halvidar, while in the White House bunker, ordered all available US forces and armed personnel to defend the city, and took the field in to directly oversee the defense of the nation’s capital, the first President to do so since James Madison. The siege lasted for just over thirty-one hours, between August 26th to August 28th.

# Background
{{History of the Mexican-American Cold War}}

## Third Mexican-American War
## Operation Stardust
# Mexican strategy
# Battle
## Battle Above the City
The first strike on the Capital Defense Platforms came in the afternoon of August 26th, 2136. Mexico’s advance had been stalled for the better part of a year, and they’d never attempted an attack so close to the American Capital before. Since the Third World War, conflicts tended to ignore civilian centers, the threat of mutually assured destruction and the interdependence of the global economy made the such slaughter too great, too unreasonable for the 22nd Century. It seemed someone forgot to tell Mexico. The fight in orbit didn't last long. By nightfall on the East Coast the Mexicans had broken through the American defense platforms and were preparing to make planetfall. On the ground, the city looked abandoned, but below the surface, the population had been evacuated to the labyrinth of shelters that had been built up of the centuries, the largest of which were retrofitted flood control channels left behind after the waters had receded in the Refreeze. The members of the government were deeper below ground in hardened bunkers built just prior to the Third World War. A great silence fell over the streets of Washington DC, interrupted only by faint screams of the drones overhead and the methodical scans of those on the ground. The nuclear flare detonated just a few hundred feet above the National Mall at 9:05 pm EST, clearing the skies for invasion.

## Fall of the Monuments
Beneath the molten slag of the Washington Monument, the first wave of Mexican Orbital Shock Commandos landed in the American Capital. Falling like snow with the unfiltered fallout, 20,000 Mexican orbital commandos make planetfall in Mexico’s greatest gambit of the war. Every simulation assured Mexico's leadership that the colonial fleet's forces would overwhelm them in short order, and with little more than a day from arrival, Mexican war planners hoped to leave their enemy leaderless, and the Colonials to salvage what remained of their Homeland, while Mexico consolidated their gains. President Halvidar, and most of the US Congress survived the attack, as Mexico knew they would, safe beneath the surface of the Capital with much of the civilian population that hadn’t already left the city during the fight in orbit. The 4th Orbital Shock Corps were the first to arrive, and were greeted by a hail of micro-artillery from the few drones that had survived the nuclear flare on the outskirts of the city. The Americans quickly established strong points at the White House and on Capitol Hill, sending scouts to deploy razor fields and smart-mines between the Reflecting Pool and the White House, shielding the Theodore Roosevelt and Arlington Bridges for reinforcements. Dress Marines, Capital Police, and what few National Guard and Space Forces that had entered the city before the nuclear flare, now made up the bulk of the American defense. President Halvidar had sent out orders to any units in the area to come and defend the Capital when the first missile hit the Capital Defense Platforms 9 hours prior, but with most of their Atlantic forces tied up in the Gulf, the fight for DC was set to be the most desperate of the war.

The 4th Shock Corps were joined 3 hours later by the 7th and 1st Commando Divisions, after sending the 11th division south to hold the Case and Price memorial bridges against the US 5th Army which was preparing to cross into DC from Virginia. Armored soldiers and drones engaged in scuffles above Jefferson Island in the heaviest fighting of the Battle for DC, while National Guard Forces crossed the Arlington Bridge to meet the 7th Commando division. US Forces established positions at the ruins of the Temple of the Union, taking the high ground against the Mexican forces near the ruins of the Korean War memorial. The forces at the Lincoln Memorial had brought with them micro-artillery and laser defense batteries, providing the city with much needed relief from Mexican missile barrages. The batteries grounded most of Mexico’s flyers above the reflecting pool and gave the White House a reprieve from the 4th Shock Corps attempts to take the building. As the sun rose on August 27th, Mexico had now established the battle-lines in the West of the City, while forces from Maryland and Virginia rushed to save the Nations’ Capital.

## Siege of Capitol Hill
While US reinforcements from Virginia had kept the heaviest fighting to the west of the city, reinforcements from the North were only just filtering in by 10 am. Spreading out from the secondary landing zone just north of the Smithsonian, the 1st Commando Division faced only a small smart-mine trench and a force of 500 American militia and regular Army soldiers defending Capitol Hill. Supported by only a few dozen crowd suppression drones, and one hastily reactivated mortar launcher from the last war, the Americans tried to buy as much time as possible to evacuate the Congress or receive help from National Guard units from Maryland. With the Capitol dome crumbling from a combination of age and the heat that split the sky, the US forces made a desperate stand against the Mexican commandos. Reinforcements from Maryland finally arrived at Union Station by 5pm on the 27th. Barely assembled and with only the old stone building to shield them from the barrage of laser fire and impactor rounds from the 111th Commando regiment, the National Guard forces held the line, but were unable to move from their makeshift castle and come to the relief of the Hill. Despite their best efforts, the 81st and 9th Commando regiments took the Capitol Building by midnight August 28th, running up the Mexican flag atop the Statue of Freedom, and taking the few members of the government unfortunate enough to have missed the tram out of the city as POWs. This included 22 members of Congress.

## White House Siege
The loss of Capitol Hill seemed to spell the end for the Americans. Mexico had finally crossed over to hold the bridges on Jefferson Island while the 90th Commando regiment formed a secondary defensive line against the 5th Army in Jacobi Row. What was left of the White House was all that stood in the way of a Mexican Victory. With most US forces on the continent fighting in the Southwest and the Gulf, those that had rushed to defend DC barely numbered 5,000. President Halvidar and the Mexican commandos prepared for the final skirmish of the Battle of Washington. President Halvidar emerged from the bunker of the White House; surrounded by marines, and armored in old CVA-7 Armor, not used since the Guardiola Incident.

At 1:14 am, the first wave of the Colonial Fleet entered Earth Orbit. After redlining their ship’s reactors to arrive just a few hours early upon hearing of the invasion of DC, the colonials entered into combat with the Mexican Orbitals. Half the fleet remained to combat the Díaz Orbital forces at the Moon, while the other half made their way to Earth. The battle in orbit continued for another 3 hours, with Mexico sending everything they had to stop the Colonials from reaching DC. Mexican Vacuum Commandos and US Space Marines engaged in heavy fighting just 200 km above DC. The Mexicans had finally entered the White House Grounds, shooting down the last few drones in the sky and detonating the smart mine field with laser support from the bombardment ships that originally destroyed the Capital Defense Platforms. With the Battlefield Command Net now largely disabled, President Halvidar began directly commanding troops, as Mexico’s commanding General, Heriberto Bautista, joined his own men to take the White House.

## Arrival of Reinforcements
As the fighting began to enter the third and final morning, the soldiers on the ground looked to the sky on August 28th at 4:21 am EST. Above the ruins of DC, the sky lit up with trails of fire. Tens of thousands of Marines from the colonies had broken through the Mexican orbitals, and were now screaming toward the surface. Landing across the city, and supported by swarms of drones and a hail of micro-artillery, the colonial reinforcements finally joined the fight for DC. The bulk of these forces landed just behind the Mexican 4th Shock Corps, outnumbering them 2 to 1, fresh from battle in orbit. With the American President still in command, and the colonial forces on the ground and in space, it was only a matter of time. The fighting continued for another 5 hours, and with support fire from the Colonial fleet, the way was cleared for the 5th Army and the National Guard to take back the city from the Mexicans. Bautista finally surrendered at 10:02 am on August 28th, 2136. 

# Aftermath

# History
In 1997 NASA launched the Mars Pathfinder mission, landing a small lander and the first interplanetary rover in what was once the Ares Vallis of Chryse Planitia. The lander was later renamed the Carl Sagan Memorial Station, while the rover, Sojourner, operated for 92 sols before losing power. And for nearly 40 years the sands of Mars would burry these robotic pioneers in dust.

When terraforming began in the 2030s, NASA was charged with preserving sites and artifacts on the surface considered to be of special historical or scientific interest. The Pathfinder spacecraft were no exception, and were exhumed by 2037. Carl Sagan Memorial Station would become the site of a permanent scientific instillation  that would grow into a network of facilities spread over hundreds of square kilometers. The original settlement would eventually become the city of Sojourner while the network of research bases would form the core of the eventual Sagan Territory established after World War III by President Jacobi.

As the once dry Ares Vallis became the thriving Ares Sound, Sagan went from being a relatively underpopulated network of research stations to a top destination of immigrants from Earth. Its research bases became part of the Sagan University System, which remains one of the greatest systems of higher education in the Sol System. While founded as a place of learning, Sagan has become a primarily maritime oriented society, with some of the busiest ports and shipyards on Mars.

Most of the population is concentrated around the Bay of Galilaei centered on the city of Tana which bestrides the inlet of the same name. Tana is home to one of the lesser Universities of the SU system, SU Tana, which is really only known for its contributions to the Martian shipbuilding industry. The crown jewel of the SU system is in the capital city of Sojourner, the Sagan Institute of Technology or SIT. It was SIT scientists who first proved the existence of the Graviton in the lab, and has since become one of the most important players in the field of Gravitonics.

The '''Scientific Schism''', also known as the '''New Oriental Schism''', or the '''Schism of 2101''' (Latin: ''Magnum schisma scientificum''), was a split within the Catholic Church lasting from 2101 to 2133 in which bishops residing in Rome and Licheń both claimed to be the true pope. The schism was driven by blowback from [Third Vatican Council](3619-sixth-great-awakening.md) the and the earlier [Proclamation of Sapere aude](1690-proclamation-of-sapere-aude.md). There was also a political element to the schism with the Licheń papacy being closely associated with the Polish government and the See of Rome being much closer to Mexico. These rival claims to the papal throne damaged the prestige of the office.

The schism was finally resolved when the Licheń claimant Pius XIII called the Council of Seville (2130–2134) after the death of Pope Adrian VII. The Council arranged the renunciation of the Licheń antipope Pius XIII, renounced many of the positions of the Third Council while maintaining the Biblical translations compiled by that council, and elected John-Paul III as the new pope reigning from Rome.

# History
## Third Vatican Council
## Two Papacies
### See of Licheń
The See of Licheń saw a more direct relationship with its patron government in [Poland](939-poland.md), with Pope Pius XIII overseeing the beginning of each session of the Sejm and swearing in each President and Prime Minister.  

The Licheń church also sought to gather legitimacy within the broader [Intermarium](946-intermarium.md) by inducting local [armored infantry](1111-armor.md) mercenary groups as official religious military orders. Three most distinct being the Order of Brothers of the German House of Saint Mary in Brandenburg (the New Teutonic Order), the Order of Saint Jadwiga, and the Order of Saint Stephen.  
### See of Rome
The resurgence of military orders in the Intermarium, which coincided with the new era of warfare centered around armor-wearing troopers ever since the [Third World War](107-world-war-iii.md), who are seen as modern knights, soon spread across Europe. The Rome church eventually did the same as well in response to the Licheń church, seeing such actions as highly provocative and even heretical. Various religious orders allegiant to the See of Rome and its pope, many of which were originally military orders of knights during the Crusades of the medieval period nearly a millennium prior, saw their historic, original roles and duties reestablished, become religious military orders once again. 

However, unlike their counterparts in the Licheń church, the Rome church’s military orders inducted less armored infantry mercenaries in comparison. Instead, they relied more on religiously devoted armored troopers volunteered from the [Latin American Union](2289-latin-american-union.md) and the Mexican Sphere, especially [Mexico](1391-mexico.md), as well as their own wealth, members, and volunteers to build up their own armored forces in the process. Four most distinct and well-known being the Order of Brothers of the German House of Saint Mary in Jerusalem (the original Teutonic Order, with no relations to the New Teutonic Order in the Intermarium), the Order of Knights of the Hospital of Saint John of Jerusalem (the Knight Hospitaller), the Order of Christ and of the Temple of Solomon (the New Knights Templar), and the Order of the Holy Sepulchre.  

While aren’t a religious military order themselves, the Pontifical Swiss Guard too was also transformed into an armored military force. Besides their age-old ceremonial duty as honor guard, the Swiss Guard still maintained its long-held duty of protecting the See of Rome and its pope. In their function as bodyguards, they are equipped with modern armors used by both the Swiss Army’s armored corps and various Rome-allegiant military orders. Similar historically, volunteers to the Swiss Guard must come from Switzerland, albeit with some differences due to the modern progressive society of the 22nd century unlike in the past. Recruits to the guards must be unmarried Swiss Catholic males and females (instead of just males like historically) between 19 and 30 years of age who have completed not just basic training but also officer and armored infantry training (instead of just basic training like in the past) with the Swiss Armed Forces. 

## Resolution

The '''New Confederacy''' was a far-right proto-state that emerged during the [White Tide](3593-white-tide.md) following the collapse of the [Sovereign Citizen's Alliance](2718-sovereign-citizen-s-alliance.md), surviving from 2031 to 2034.

The New Confederacy was built upon the ideas of Southern nationalism, seeking to create an independent state for the South, similar to the original Confederacy of the Civil War. The New Confederacy similarly seceded from the Union, only to be fully defeated by 2034. During its existence, the New Confederacy's government was characterized by ultraconservative policies and being in a state of rebellion throughout its whole history. For the majority of its existence its territorial control was limited to isolated communities in the Appalachia mountains.

The '''American Redoubt''' officially the ''Northwest American Republic'' ('''NAR''') and sometimes known as the '''Northwestern Front''' was a far-right proto-state based mostly in Idaho, Montana, and Wyoming.

The ideas of the Redoubt came from two sources: on top of the original American Redoubt idea intended on creating a community for conservative Christians, the Redoubt later took in ideas of the Northwest Territorial Imperative, which sought to create a White ethno-state in the same region. The flag of the Redoubt would later reflect this. Similar to other far-right rebel governments of the [White Tide](3593-white-tide.md), the American Redoubt was characterized by ultraconservatism and racism. Unlike some other far-right rebels, the American Redoubt was not based upon historical independence movements, and solely cared about creating a state for the White race, and not some geographic area (e.g. the South). Eventually, even after the federal government would eliminate most insurgents, violence would periodically break out in Idaho. Even after most of the White Tide ceased in the early 2030s, federal troops would later continue with rooting out insurgents from the Rocky Mountains until the fall of Salmon Idaho in 2035.

The '''Christian Republic''' was a far-right state during the [White Tide](3593-white-tide.md), actively involved in seeking independence from the [United States](217-united-states-of-america.md).

The Christian Republic had origins in the Christian Right that had emerged in the mid 20th century and American immigration policies of the 2020s, mostly upon taking in large amounts of immigrants from different backgrounds, especially religious ones. As the government become more left-wing, some Americans felt that the government no longer represented Christian interests. Once the [White Tide](3593-white-tide.md) began, far-right Christian groups joined the [SCA](2718-sovereign-citizen-s-alliance.md) in the hopes of overthrowing the current government and re-establishing America as a "Christian Nation." After the collapse of the SCA in 2031, these Christian militants broke off to form an overtly secessionist government.

The Christian Republic would ultimately fail in its secessionist attempt, being overpowered by federal troops due in part to a lack of defensible positions, poor coordination with its military units (mostly comprised of former NDF members), and infighting with other far right groups. The Christian Republic was predominantly based in the Great Plains and was founded shortly before the Drive Across the Plains. During its time, the Christian Republic mostly focused on implementing a strict version of Christian law, which involved anti-LGBTQ policies. The Christian Republic was not unique among rebel groups of the White Tide for its strong usage of religious text to implement laws, the [New Confederacy](3669-new-confederacy.md), 2nd Republic of Texas, and the SCA frequently used religious justification for its laws.

'''Terminus''' is the 9th Planet from the sun and the farthest known planet in the [solar system](1583-sol-system.md). The planet is named after [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Terminus_(god) Terminus, the roman god of borders.]

# Moons
Terminus is a Super Earth, 10.14 times more massive than Earth, and 2.77 times the size. It has 11 satellites, most of which are in highly elliptical orbits and believed to be captured Kuiper Belt Objects. Its two largest moons, Sabine and Titus, have diameters of 905 km and 1311 km respectively. Due to the extreme distance from the Sun, and relatively limited economic value, Terminus only has a population of a few thousand researchers and engineers. 

## Titus
Titus is the second largest moon of Terminus and its largest population center. Titus is cryosphere comparable to Europa, Ganymede, Callisto, or Enceladus with a small subsurface ocean. While most residents of Terminus live on its [Orbitals](1477-orbitals.md), the presence of liquid water in the subsurface ocean of Titus makes it the most important center for economic activity.

## Sabine
Sabine is the largest and most massive moon of Terminus. Sabine is slated to be deorbited down system to [Venus](1154-venus.md) to serve as its new moon, via one of the most ambitious [gravity propulsion projects ever attempted.](3656-gravitonics.md) There is an ongoing debate to rename Sabine "Cupid" in honor of its future position.

'''Alo ''', also known as '''YBP1194 c''' is the third planet orbiting the G-type main-sequence star YBP1194, and the homeworld of the [Argommi](1749-argommi.md). The YBP1194 system is located in the open cluster M67 in the constellation Cancer, some 2,920 lightyears from [Earth](272-earth.md). It is one of only two exoplanets to produce an industrial civilization, the other being [Tel-ma](1667-tel-ma.md).

Alo has a mass 71% and a radius 83% that of Earth, leading to a gravitational pull of 10.09 m/s^2. 82% of its surface is covered with water, with three continental or subcontinental masses inhabited by industrial civilizations. The planet once had considerably more land prior to a climate shift that resulted from a comet strike in a taiga forest region. Atmospheric pressure is 109% that of Earth.

# History
Complex life first emerged on Alo some 570 million years ago, around the time of other Life Explosions that have been positively identified on many life-bearing planets, further contributing to the Sag A* Great Filter Hypothesis. Based on archeological data most land-dwelling "vertebrates" on Alo evolved from an ancient clade of sea slugs, with hydrostatic muscles. These evolved a skeletal structure--based on copper, not calcium as on Earth-- as adaptations to life on land about 400 million years ago.

The current clade that dominates the Alo biosphere emerged some 90-110 mya and shares many biomechanical features with Earth's Synapsids. These organisms are usually warm blooded, scaled, and often have a form of fur or psuedofeathers. The largest terrestrial Aloan Synapsids exhibits a body plan similar to Deinocheirus, and possesses a large mane. The Argommi themselves possess vestigial body hair and a scalp similar to that of humans. Most vertebrates on Alo are egg-layers, with the majority of these incubating their soft-shelled egg cases in a ventral brood pouch. This pouch can be found in specimens with both male and female reproductive organs, a common feature across the biosphere, giving rise to the Aloan scientific community's use of four gender groups.

# Human exploration
Humans began charting the YBP1194 system in 2013 with the discovery of YBP1194 b, a Hot Jupiter with a mass projected at roughly 34% that of Jupiter. With an orbital period of just under a Terran week, and an eccentric orbit 0.24 (similar to Pluto), it was disregarded as a potential candidate for life.

Later observations using the [United Interferometer Network](1592-nasa.md) charted the entire planetary system in greater detail. A total of 12 planets were identified. YBP1194 c was identified in 2052 as a habitable world.

YBP1194 was considered a desirable destination for the [first generation of warp ships.](3728-enterprise-class-interstellar-vehicle.md) However, it would take another 30 years before NASA even began formally preparing for such a mission, due to the extreme distances involved. No spacecraft fitted with a the early generations of the White-Alcubierre Drive were capable of reaching YBP1194 in what NASA considered to be a reasonable amount of time. With so many desirable worlds far closer, NASA deferred the mission until the [Falcon-class interstellar vehicle](3730-falcon-class-intstellar-vehicle.md) began development in the 2080s. When the first Odysseus-series of probes started to enter production, NASA was given support by Congress to prepare a mission to YBP1194 c. On April 1, 2088 the probes Odysseus VIII, IX, X, and XI were launched toward YP1194 to chart a safe path for a crewed interstellar vehicle. The Odysseus IX and X were lost after the first 5 years, and the Odysseus VIII after 7 years. After 15 years, and 700 transits at warp, the Odysseus XI safely reached the YBP1194 system on July 4, 2103. 

Having only traveled half a light year on its last transit, Odysseus XI's Bubble Trap produced a relatively small blast of radiation visible as a twinkling star from the surface of Alo. By all accounts, this went unnoticed by the all but two amateur astronomers who were unable to identify a source. Their log entries identifying the light they saw would not be reported until after First Contact. Odysseus XI spent two years charting the planetary system and observing Alo, confirming the presence of intelligent life. Upon confirming the presence of an industrial civilization, NASA changed the flight schedule for the IV-402 Beagle III to conduct first contact.

# Pre-contact geopolitics
Since the establishment of the Tilio'ramna Pact in 2047, power on Alo has been divided into 5 major supranational entities with varying degrees of integration of their member states. Only the city-state of X'anlio'ramna has remained unaffiliated and completely neutral since the start of this era, a consequence of it being located in the Tavurl Mountains and not easily accessible by any single power.

## Osomi CoDominium
{{Infobox former country
 | conventional_long_name = Osomi CoDominium
 | native_name = 
 | common_name = OC
 | _noautocat = yes
 | status = [Collective defense and economic union](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Wikipedia:Collective_security)
 | continent = Osomi
 | era =

Made up of most of the Osomi continental mass, and far and away the largest economic bloc on the planet prior to First Contact. The OC is a singular economic union and mutual defense pact. From New Glava in the Djanni Republic, the member nations of the OC send delegates to the CoDominium Parliament, which elects a Director General from its ranks. Per the Treaty of Molyog and the OC Charter, member nations surrender monetary policy to the CoDominium Central Bank, while the parliament sets CoDominium-wide limits to the fiscal policy of its member nations. 

The OC was founded after the second planetary war as an free trade zone and currency union among the nations around Sonhams Bay, all of which were former Hakloan colonies. Over the subsequent decades the other former Hakloan colonies in the Northeast of Osomi joined, with the bulk of the continent coming under the CoDominium during third planetary war of 2064 (Earth calendar). During that conflict, the Osomi nations had created a collective defense bloc and unified naval command system which would serve as the foundation for the Treaty of New Glava, evolving the economic union into a joint collective defense and economic pact.

## Tilio'ramna Pact
{{Infobox former country
 | conventional_long_name = Tilio'ramna Pact
 | native_name = 
 | common_name = TP
 | _noautocat = yes
 | status = [Collective defense and economic union](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Wikipedia:Collective_security)
 | continent = Haklo
 | era =

Made up of most of the Haklo continental mass. Considered the second most powerful bloc on the planet, the Tilio'ramna Pact was the most regressive prior to First Contact. Most of its member states practiced a form of indentured servitude or serfdom with around 10-15% of the population being in bondage. Prior to First Contact, many if not most of the Pact members had some form of an emancipation movement, and servile rebellions were not uncommon.

Despite its economic power and historical prestige, most on Alo agreed that pre-First Contact the Tilio'ramna Pact was on the decline. They had lost the last planetary war with the Osomi CoDominium, and were struggling to keep pace militarily with the OC. The alliance was also facing an inverted demography, with an elderly dependency ratio comparable to early 20th century Europe, while Osomi still had a young and growing population. The annual war games of the Pact suggested that the next planetary war would not only end with another OC victory, but that their Navy would not be able to hold their position at all in the Taura Sea. There was also a movement within the leadership class of the North Hakloan Security Organization to abandon neutrality and ally with the OC should the TP be unable to hold their half of the Taura Sea. There was also a fear that the OC's covert attempts to support the Pact's servile insurrections would eventually destabilize many of its member states. 

Facing the choice of subjugation or potential destruction, First Contact offered the TP leadership a third option in which they could be equal members with the OC in dealing with humanity. Further, humans offered technologies that would provide them the means of overcoming their demographic problems while the Pact's capital base was still intact, and considerably larger than the OCs. This is considered fundamental to the TPs willingness to create the Common Defense Pact.

## Canavin Union
{{Infobox former country
 | conventional_long_name = Canavin Union
 | native_name = 
 | common_name = CU
 | _noautocat = yes
 | status = [Commercial and defensive confederation](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Wikipedia:Collective_security)
 | continent = Haklo
 | era = 
 | event_start = Treaty of Van Croy
 | year_start = 2064
 | date_start =
 | event_end = Second Treaty of Sansomi
 | year_end = 2131
 | date_end = 
 | event2 =

 | date_event1 = 2113

 | image_map2_caption = 
 }}

At the time of First Contact, the Canavin island-continent was fully unified under the CU, which had reached a point in its political evolution to resemble a Federation of states, rather than multiple, trade zones and mutual defense organizations. It was considered a fairly progressive entity prior to First Contact, having instituted a democratic legislature for its security council, created a single charter guaranteeing the rights of the residents of the CU in every member nation regardless of race or creed, and even made progress on queer rights.

As the only major landmass in the northern hemisphere, Canavin's geography gave the population a sense of isolation and independence from the rest of the planet, and they developed a culture that tended to be almost contrarian when it concerned their southern neighbors and former colonial overlords. Further, while they were by no means left out of the First Contact negotiations in Sansomi, the TP and OC's willingness to work together when dealing with the humans meant that Canavin was always being treated as a second rate power. There was a perception among the Canavin member nations that their former colonial masters were attempting to gain the favor of an advanced alien benefactor for the purposes of once again subjugating their old colonies. Canavin's leaders made the choice to not join what would become the CDP quite clear: between the choice of subjugation and isolation, they choose isolation.

## NHSO

 | common_name = NHSO

Located along the north-central coast of Haklo, the NHSO was a comparatively minor power, but had the geographic defensibly and wealth to maintain its independence from the TU. Nominally seen as the more progressive bloc on Haklo, the NHSO has endeavored to maintain neutrality between the other blocs.

## CCMS
{{Infobox former country
 | conventional_long_name = Cooperation Council of Masenkan States
 | native_name = 
 | common_name = CCMS
 | _noautocat = yes
 | status = [Collective defense and economic union](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Wikipedia:Collective_security)
 | continent = Osomi

The smallest of the blocs, and the only one to be completely landlocked. The CCMS is located in the interior of Osomi, and the majority of its territory is scrubland and desert, with most of its population centered on the south shore of the Lonli megalake. The CCMS has a largely cordial relationship with the Kuvo Republic, and through that is able to maintain favorable relations with the rest of the OC. It is the only non-nuclear supranational entity on Alo, and militarily its independence is maintained by the impassibility of its territory.

## First Contact
IV-402 ''Beagle III'' departed the Sol System for the YBP1194 system on August 20, 2105 for a 7 year transit, a duration second only to the relief mission to [Tel-ma](1667-tel-ma.md) beginning in 2091. On January 9, 2112 the ''Beagle III'' reached the edge of the YBP1194 system. Antimatter propulsion ceased on January 15, 2112, and construction of the YBP1194 [Beachhead Orbital](1477-orbitals.md) began on February 1. The crew of the ''Beagle III'' was completely awoken from suspended animation by March 3, 2112, and satellites manufactured from the Trojan asteroid and real-time data from Odysseus XI confirmed not only advanced industrial civilizations but large ground based observatories, which convinced NASA to issue an order to ''Beagle III'' to halt all plans for uncrewed landings and to instead prioritize First Contact-at-a-distance or radio First Contact on April 2, 2112. For the next year, the crew of the ''Beagle III'' would use their satellite network to tap into the radio and TV signals of the planet. They made no attempt to mask the presence of the satellites orbiting Alo, as it was assumed any civilization with ground based observatories on the scale of Alo's would have been able to spot an anti-matter driven spacecraft.

''' Theia'''-class was [NASA](1592-nasa.md)'s second crewed interstellar vehicle program. Entering service in 2082, the  Theia more than doubled NASA's crewed interstellar fleet and made some significant increases in performance and reliability from the older [Hyperion.](3645-hyperion-interstellar-vehicle.md)  Six complete  Theia interstellar vehicles were built and flown on a total of 135 missions from 2082 to 2152, with IV-206 ''Odyssey '' holding the record for the longest service life of any interstellar spacecraft.

# Design and Development
In the mid 2070s it was becoming clear that the ''Hyperion'' would need to be retired in the next ten years or require major refits to continue safe operation. On September 24, 2076, NASA released a study concluding that a new vehicle was required to satisfy the agency's future demands and outlined desired improvements over the Hyperion for the new class of interstellar vehicle. The head of the NASA Office of Manned Spaceflight, Mariah Mueller, announced the plan for a next-generation interstellar vehicle on August 10, 2078. NASA issued a request for proposal (RFP) for designs of the Interstellar Vehicle Second Generation Program or IV-2XX, which would later become the  Theia. In December 2078, NASA created the Interstellar Vehicle 2XX Task Group to determine the optimal design for the new class of spacecraft. A year later they issued a report that determined the IV-2XX would support longer-duration crewed missions beyond the Sol System. The group formally released the report in 2079 calling for a spacecraft nearly double the size of the Hyperion, and increasing its warp cruising "speed" from 12 to 50 times the speed of light.

After the release of the IV-2XX Task Group report, NASA contractors put forth several proposed designs based on research done since the launch of the first Prometheus probe on warp tori design. The winning bid would grant NASA the desired 50x light speed target, but would fail to double the size of the crew module. Instead NASA would have to settle for a 70% larger crewed section or 59.5 meters. The Hexagon arrangement for the Crew Return Vehicles was kept, as was the antimatter propulsion bus despite lingering calls to discontinue antimatter propulsion following the Constitution Disaster. All told, the  Theia was an iterative improvement to the ''Hyperion'' with reliability being its highest priority, contributing to its longevity as an interstellar vehicle.

'''Prometheus 1''' was an American space probe, the first to utilize a White-Alcubierre Drive or Warp Drive, which was launched to the Alpha Centauri System  11 October 2059. It was used to chart a safe course to the system and then conduct scientific surveys of the system and its planets prior to any human mission. The flight out took 18 months in which the warp drive was active for 5 jumps.

Prometheus 1 would be the progenitor to not only all [crewed warp capable spacecraft](3728-enterprise-class-interstellar-vehicle.md), but also the 18 successive probes of the Prometheus program which were used extensively by NASA to chart safe courses through interstellar space and conduct missions of exploration and scientific observation prior to human contact. As of 2160, only the Prometheus 1, 9, and 14 have survived the program, with Prometheus 1 being featured in the Smithsonian Space Museum. Prometheus 9 and 14 are still in use, orbiting the neutron stars RX J1856.5−3754 and PSR J0108−1431.

# Design
The Prometheus project was unique among interstellar space probes in that they predate [chronoscopes](1437-chronoscope.md) and thus had to conduct far more warp jumps to provide an even semi-accurate simulation of interstellar space.

The '''Seikarte''' are the only [intelligent lifeforms](3723-list-of-sophonts.md) native to the planet Seika. At time of First Contact in 2071, the most advanced societies on the planet were organized into soilworks building heading communities, with a limited form of agriculture used to cultivate fodder for livestock and a type of highly fibrous or "wood" grass-like reed used in both construction and fabric. The Seikarte are one of the first Sophonts to be popularly labeled a "Wood Age" civilization, a term used to describe the bulk of post-paleolithic societies observed by humanity.

The '''National Defense Force''' (often shortened to '''NDF''') was the unified military of the [MAGA regime](2718-sovereign-citizen-s-alliance.md) during the [Second American Civil War](3593-white-tide.md).

# History
## Formation
The National Defense Force was formed through the consolidation of multiple state defense forces, militias, police departments, and some National Guard units in Republican-controlled red states shortly after the MAGA pretender government was formed in Mar-a-Lago and hostilities broken out against Democrat-governed blue states. 

## First Battle of Scott AFB
## Siege of Chicago
## Battle of Houston
## First Battle of Kansas
## Second Battle of Kansas
## Second Battle of Scott AFB
## Battle for the Upland South
## Drive Across the Plains
## Battle of Omaha/Omaha Mutiny
## Battle of Rapid City
# Organization
Officially, the National Defense Force was a de-jure police force similar to the state defense forces, albeit with a highly militarized nature akin to a military police force of an army rather a regular civilian police one. Thus, rather than the Secretary of Defense of the MAGA pretender government, it was under the jurisdiction of the Attorney General, who held the second highest level of civilian authority; MAGA President Donald Trump Jr. held executive authority over the NDF. In reality, however, it was the de-facto primary military force of the regime and movement throughout the war up until the collapse of the MAGA united front in 2031 at the Battle of Rapid City. 

The NDF was directed by the Supreme Command organized under General Michael Flynn as Supreme Commander of the NDF, with the Presidency of Donald Trump Jr. continuing to serve as the Commander-in-Chief and the Attorney General acting as the official civilian head of the military. 

## Army groups
The National Defense Force was notionally organized into six army groups: Central, South, West, East, Mountain, and Capital. These army groups were further divided into field armies in each state. In reality, only the Capital Army Group (CAG) existed as a truly organized formation; the rest were a disorganized array of units operating in a semi-independent manner.  

## Branches
The largest branch of the NDF was its ground forces, tasked with fighting Federal forces across almost every front. The limited air, naval, cyber, and space forces the MAGA regime controlled were not independent branches and were instead sub-commands of the NDF. 

## Units
Being a motley consolidation of multiple independent units, the National Defense Force was not a homogenous force. Many units operated independently of the theoretical chain of command, with the only instances of organized military structure between units occurring when officers from the Capital Army Group took command, as was the case during the First Battle of Scott AFB when General Charles Flynn took command of the Indiana and Missouri state defense forces, the Indiana State Guard and the Missouri State Guard respectively. 

The state defense forces and later the NDF were commanded primarily by former higher ranking police officers, military officers forced into early retirement, and military personnel and officers who defected when the war began. In some cases, like in the Idaho State Guard, which was the pre-war state defense force of Idaho, their officer corps would go as far as employing foreign mercenary soldiers as advisors and even commanders. 

# Personnel
The NDF were originally composed of former police officers, retired military personnel, and new volunteers from right-wing youth groups who enlisted during the years lead up to the war, with these troops forming the backbone of various state defense forces in Republican-controlled red states that preceded the NDF. 

The combined state defense forces nationwide by 2029 was around half a million (500,000 to 600,000 troops), as large as the Israel Defense Forces or the Islamic Republic of Iran Armed Forces. The consolidation, conscription of various police departments that has been provincialized the years led up to the war, and drafting of young men in red states when the war began would mean the NDF's ranks would reach into the millions at its peak.

## Ranks
Rank structures of the National Defense Force were mostly identical to that of the U.S. Army with some slight differences. The highest military rank in the NDF was the Supreme Commander of the National Defense Force, a rank equivalent to the U.S. Army’s 6-star rank of “General of the Armies.” General Michael Flynn was the only NDF officer to ever held the rank until his capture and at the Battle of Omaha/Omaha Mutiny.

## Conscription
The first act of the MAGA regime was to consolidate the state defense forces and provincialized police departments across every red states into the National Defense Force, as well as introducing conscription for the first time in America since the end of the Vietnam War.

Immediately after the draft was imposed, 300,000 young men aged 18 and above throughout red states across the country were drafted into the NDF, a number that would only rise as the war progressed. As a result, contrary to the myth and image of the NDF and the MAGA regime being regarded as “a bunch of old men rebelling against the young”, the conscription law saw most NDF conscripts being quite young. Only the NCOs and the officers of the NDF were much older compared to Federal forces, usually taken from the state defense forces, which were in turn largely retired military veterans and taken from police departments.

When the Drive Across the Plains began in 2031, around 65% of the NDF was made up of draftees. The nature of the draft and the deteriorating conditions for the NDF and the MAGA regime as the war progressed also saw widespread desertions and retreats, leading to the deployment of barrier troops by the NDF. 

The death or capture of more experienced troops, NCOs, and officers as time went on further led to the MAGA regime conscripting teenagers younger than 18. While right-wing teenagers were already known to enlist in the state defense forces before 2029, the worsening conditions of the war saw the conscription of teenagers, children, and old men increased at an unprecedented level. Officially, only teenagers 16 and older were drafted, but unofficially, children as young as 12 serving as rear echelon troops during the last days of the regime. 

On paper, the regime’s official draft laws stated that the minimum length of mandatory military service is two years for all conscripted men, during which time all men aged 18 and above were required to serve in the NDF for at least one term. However, many captured NDF troops during the Drive Across the Plains (August-September 2031) were discovered to have served since as early as January 2029, several months longer than their stated service periods. 

Due to the high level of corruption, influences, powers, and privileges of pro-MAGA corporations under the regime and its territories, the wealthy elites and their children were able to avoid military service with very little effort, even as the frontlines began to collapse. Many opted to flee to non-extradition countries or take their own lives before Federal forces could reach their estates. 

## International volunteers
The NDF and its associated groups and organizations received many international supporters and volunteers, especially from European far-right groups. Many joined the fight by crossing the Mexican border as the security of said border was not a priority for the Federal forces initially. After 2031, however, the influx of foreign volunteers declined as the border was secured and Federal naval forces maintained control of the nation's ports. 

## Minorities in the NDF
### Hispanics and Latinos
### Blacks
### Asians
### Jews
### Indigenous
### LGBTQ+ people
## Training
For the most part, military training in the National Defense Forces was largely similar to the Federal forces of the U.S. Armed Forces initially. However, as the war deteriorated for the MAGA regime, along with the death of experienced troops and officers as times went on, the NDF would increasingly relied on inexperienced conscripts, many of whom received little to no formal military training. One NDF soldier captured during the Battle of Omaha recounted how his training lasted only two weeks, during which he was given a rifle and fired only a hundred rounds at a paper target as his "training". 

# Culture
## Hazing
Unsurprisingly, the culture of machismo, homophobia, misogyny, and toxic masculinity of the MAGA movement and the right-wing in general resulted in rampant and bad hazings within the military culture and rank of the state defense forces and the NDF. 

Examples of brutal hazing included corporal punishments, abuses, bullying, beatings, sexual harassments and assaults, and more inflicted upon male soldiers (women were not allowed to serve in the NDF under the MAGA regime) during training and within units by instructors, NCOs, superior officers, Evangelical military chaplains, and fellow soldiers when being perceived as “weak”, “traitorous”, “unchristian”, “degenerate”, “emasculated/feminine”, “gay”, etc. Troops were constantly tested for loyalty, and church services were mandatory in the NDF. Flogging was also normal and common for even minor infractions.

Some state defense forces and pro-MAGA rebel militias would went as far as to ritualized their hazings. The Idaho State Guard, which became a part of the NDF Mountain during the war up until 2031, was the most well-known and infamous example of this when they hired ex-Wagner Group mercenaries. These Russian advisors and commanders would introduced the practice of ritualized abuses and hazings similar to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dedovshchina Dedovshchina] found in the Russian military and the Wagner Group.

As the civil war progressed and deteriorated for the NDF, hazing would worsened as the MAGA regime was looking for any solutions to avoid its utter, inevitable defeat out of mounting fear, paranoia, and exclusion, blaming its troops, commanders, and even its own officials for perceived signs of weakness, degeneracy, and more.

## War crimes
# Weapons and equipment
## Uniforms
There were no standard uniform specifications across the NDF, with many units using whatever they could get their hands on, from police coveralls to military surplus, along with a few modern uniforms made for each state.

One of the more common combat uniforms used were surplus UCP uniforms used by various state defense forces and formerly by the U.S. Army. Other units used the more modern OCP MultiCam combat uniforms worn by Federal forces (resulting in instances of friendly fire) as well as a variety of surplus and civilian camouflage patterns.

Similar to the combat uniform situations, there were also hardly any standard dress uniforms. For the most part, the most common dress uniforms of the NDF was the US Army Blue Service Uniforms and various different police ceremonial dress uniforms due to the similarities between the two.

## Firearms
AR-15 rifles and 9mm handguns made up the majority of the NDF's individual firearms due to their mass proliferation in the civilian and military sectors. As a result, ammunition and spare parts were plentiful, especially 9mm and 5.56×45mm NATO bullets. One of the first military procurement programs conducted by the NDF was the production of bump stocks and extended magazines to modify their AR-15s from a purely semi-automatic platform to a select fire or fully automatic configuration, increasing the lethality of their rifles. 

Weapons seized from police armories and departments, as well as military bases and armories, also added to the NDF's stockpile. The new M7 rifle used by Federal military forces was a coveted trophy, and the limited number captured were often issued to elite units.

The Supreme Command of the NDF and the MAGA regime also ordered the seizures of civilian ammunition and small arms stocks, which was considered highly ironic given the MAGA ideology’s militant opposition to government control of civilian firearms before the war. 

## Vehicles
The bulk of the NDF's heavy vehicles came from private donations, police stocks, or through looting Federal armories and military bases. The vast stockpiles of military-grade equipment and armored vehicles acquired by police forces through the Law Enforcement Support Office (LESO) program allowed the NDF to rapidly equip many of its units with armored vehicles early on. These armored forces were very effective against the hastily recruited militias the NDF encountered early in the war. 

The NDF further expanded its vehicle fleet by taking vehicles from Federal armories, military bases, and routed Federal forces, including M1 Abrams tanks, Bradley IFVs, and Stryker APCs. However, spare parts and fuel shortages crippled the NDF's ability to maintain these heavier vehicles as the war went on, and thus simpler vehicles such as Humvees, MRAPs, and older M113 APCs were used in greater numbers. Converted civilian pickup trucks, or "[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Technical_(vehicle) technicals]", were also heavily used in great numbers due to their simple maintenance and lower fuel consumption.  

## Aircraft
At the start of the war, the NDF operated few fixed-wing aircraft captured from Federal air bases and manufacturing facilities. Its fighter wing consisted of F-15Is originally intended for export to Israel in 2029 and air show F-16s, all of which piloted by old retired pilots previously discharged from the U.S. Air Force due to sexual misconduct charges. 71 additional aircraft of varying types were acquired from Scott AFB after it was taken over.

The NDF's air fleet's readiness was rapidly attrited by a lack of fuel, spare parts, and qualified pilots and maintenance personnel. The NDF's combat fighter fleet was widely employed during the Siege of Chicago, but failed to achieve air superiority over the city before the NDF was forced to withdraw. Most aircraft were shot down, grounded due to maintenance or pilot shortages, or were rendered inoperable by a shortage of munitions. 

Helicopters commandeered from civilians and former police forces were used in a limited capacity, primarily in a backline roles where they would be safe from ground fire. One notable role of helicopters in the NDF was the rapid deployment of infantry squads to combat the scattered insurgencies throughout the Midwest, where a fast response was required before the isolated cells could retreat into hiding after conducting an attack. 

## Drones
Simple homebuilt drones and drones taken from shops were used to devastating effect against Federal forces as cheap drones and loitering munitions. Often being deployed in swarms of thousands, they first saw action during the First Battle of Scott AFB. General Eric Madden, who was the only gay officer in the NDF, pioneered UAV tactics for the NDF during the war, taking lessons from the war in Ukraine and adapting them accordingly, but his effort to organize and improve the NDF’s drone production against the much bigger drone manufacturing capability of the U.S. Air Force was frequently ignored and sidelined by the homophobic MAGA regime and the NDF itself.

'''Peter Peneus Teller''' (10 November 1967-December 2149), later known as '''Don Pedro de Alta California,''' was an entrepreneur, venture capitalist, and political activist who played a leading roll in the [Neo-Jeffersonian movement](2813-neo-jeffersonianism.md) before siding with [Mexico](1391-mexico.md) in the [Third Mexican-American War](119-third-mexican-american-war.md). An important figure in the Digital Revolution of the late 20th, early 21st centuries, Teller spent most of the mid-21st century in New Zealand before returning to the United States during the [Biorobotics boom](2618-biorobotics-boom.md). He would later, famously, renounce his American citizenship and publicly endorse [Edwin Jaso](1444-edwin-jaso.md)'s war-effort, being elevated as a ''Don '' and member of the Mexican Senate in the process. 

Near his 100th birthday Teller recognized the opportunity from the unemployment crisis spawned by biorobots and [AIOSs](1236-artificial-intelligence-operating-system.md). With more people starting to suggest ending pro-immigration policies of the Progressive Era to curtail the problem caused by automation, Teller returned to the US and became an early backer of many Neo-Jeffersonian political groups, and [Oscar Lachman](896-oscar-lachman.md) in particular. Riding high on renewed popularity following his support for [Augment Rights](1074-augment-rights-movement.md), the nascent Horizon Party pushed him as an Elder Statesmen of the anti-Progressive alliance  emerging around the world. He became the first of these self-ascribed "Yeoman Capitalists" to privatize an entire city, that being Fort Collins, CO, which by 2073 was bankrupt and facing a decade long population flight. Teller, with the state government's blessing as a pilot project, established a corporation that directly oversaw the administration of the city with a robotic workforce. After only one year then-Governor Lachman successfully pushed to implement Neo-Jeffersonian civics policies across the state based on the apparent success in Fort Collins. When Lachman eventually became President, Teller rose to become one of the biggest land-owners in the US, directly administering cities across the world, with San Jose being his crown jewel.

Teller was one of the few people to loudly oppose the Rosiland Amendment, which allowed green card holders and other immigrant workers to travel to [Mars](318-mars.md) rather than be fully deported. He lived as one of the most powerful men on Earth right up until the election of [Lionel Halvidar](212-lionel-halvidar.md) and the Union Party sweep in 2132. Teller, despite his personal racism, sided with the [Aztlan movement](1681-aztlan-war.md) and Mexico to maintain his grip on power. During the Secession Crisis of 2132, he attempted to supersede the elected government of Colorado to bring the state into the [United States of Aztlan](948-united-states-of-aztlan.md). Most observers assumed Teller would succeed, given his overwhelming control over much of the state at that time. But Halvidar was quick to use the conventional military to rout Teller's force of mercenaries before they could get organized.

Teller retreated to San Jose, and eventually Mexico City where he publicly endorsed Edwin Jaso, renounced his American citizenship, and converted to Catholicism for which he was made "Don Pedro de Alta California." After a brief term as military governor of California, Teller fled North America for one of his last personal holdings, a small [O'Neil Ship](1738-o-neil-ships.md), the ''New Darmstadt'' that originally cycled between [Earth](272-earth.md) and the [Ahuiateteo Orbitals](1477-orbitals.md). Teller and a band of retainers took the ship on a highly elliptical orbit into Trans-Neptunian Space. Teller, no longer stylizing himself as Don Pedro, and instead having adopted the title '''Autarch of New Darmstadt'''
joined his ship with the [Eternal Spring Revolt](1219-eternal-spring-revolt.md), and at 182 was killed during the Space Force's raid on the rebel colonies.

The '''Bradbury Cooperative''' was a network of Martian colonies founded with the original [Bradbury](2150-bradbury.md) settlement. Based primarily in Western Tharsis, but including settlements in the Margaritifer basin and at other points across the planet, the Bradbury CoOp was the first example of genuine self-government on [Mars](318-mars.md) that was not tied to a terrestrial entity.

The Bradbury CoOp proved to be a pivotal force during the [First Martian Revolution](1680-first-martian-revolution.md) and for this position the city of Bradbury would become the headquarters of the [Interplanetary Trade Commission](216-interplanetary-trade-commission.md) and later the formal planetary capital of Mars.

'''Army Group West''', abbreviated as '''AGWEST''' and officially known as the '''22nd Army Group''', was a [United States Army](2252-united-states-army.md) army group formed on the West Coast of the [United States](217-united-states-of-america.md) during the [White Tide](3593-white-tide.md). It was one of two army groups created to fight the [National Defense Force](3732-national-defense-force.md), the other being [Army Group East (AGEAST)](3742-ageast.md).

# History
## Formation
Like AGEAST, AGWEST was formed in response to the MAGA government's declaration of secession following the 2028 Presidential election.  

## Interstate campaigns
AGWEST's primary objectives were the control of the I-5, I-15, and I-25 highway corridors that would allow supplies to move between Federal positions in the West Coast and the Rockies. 

## Drive on the Southwest
The Fourth Army of AGWEST quickly secured the major cities of Las Vegas, Phoenix, and Santa Fe, encountering only light resistance from the NDF and militant groups. The rapid advance is also attributed to the Fourth Army's abundant access to mechanized transportation in the form of electric vehicles and the vast solar and wind farms in the Southwest that kept such vehicles powered. 

## Battle for Stevens Pass
The Tenth Army of AGWEST was heavily engaged with dislodging NDF forces at Stevens Pass in the Northern Cascade Mountains. Combat lasted for six months, with Seattle's power supply kept intact after a daring airborne operation at the Grand Coulee Dam. The battles allowed the Tenth Army to gain a considerable amount of experience in mountain warfare and asymmetric warfare. 

## Canadian operations
AGWEST nominally assumed command of most Canadian forces in British Columbia and Alberta after the government failed to adequately respond to the Christian nationalist uprising in Alberta. The combined force pushed the Army of West Canada into the Canadian Rockies, cutting off the NDF from its supply line in the north. 

## Post-MAGA insurgency
AGWEST continued counter-insurgency operations following the official surrender of the MAGA regime. It was heavily involved with fighting the [American Redoubt](3670-american-redoubt.md) in Idaho and Montana, with Tenth Army battalions and SOF teams fighting the Redoubt into the Rocky Mountains and to their final stand in the town of Salmon, Idaho.

# Units
During its existence, AGWEST controlled two field army-level commands: the Fourth Army, officially the Fourth United States Army, and the Tenth Army, officially the Tenth United States Army. It also worked with Canadian forces in the western part of Canada. 

## Fourth Army
The Fourth Army was tasked with counter-insurgency operations in the Southwest. Sparsely populated and with a light NDF presence, the Fourth Army was considered to have an easy tour of duty compared to other units and field armies.

## Tenth Army
The Tenth Army was formed from units of the California and Oregon National Guards who had recently defeated NDF forces in Redding. It would spend the majority of the war as a low priority unit fighting the NDF in the Cascade Mountains in Washington. 

## Canadian forces
With the Canadian government unable to respond to Christian nationalist uprisings in Alberta, AGWEST assumed control of most of the Canadian military forces in British Columbia and Alberta. 

# Personnel
When formed, AGWEST was primarily composed of Third Army veterans, National Guard units, and fresh civilian recruits. Civilian recruits, while motivated, were often hastily trained and deployed to guard the Cascade-Sierra line or patrol the I-5 corridor. Regular Army and National Guard personnel were tasked with directly fighting the NDF in offensive operations and securing the Interstate corridors.

Along with [Army Group West (AGWEST)](3740-agwest.md), it formed a significant part of the Federal government's forces against the MAGA government's [National Defense Force](3732-national-defense-force.md).

# History
## Formation
# Units
## First Army
The First Army was engaged in battles in the Great Lakes areas and gained fame during the defense of Rock Island Arsenal and the rescue of besieged Chicago. 

## Third Army
Considered to be the backbone of AGEAST, the Third Army fought on the East Coast in the defense of Washington, D.C. and the Northeastern Green Zone. It was primarily made up of veteran enlisted soldiers and officers who had participated in the Middle Eastern wars of the 2010s. 

## Fifth Army
The Fifth Army became well-known for its defense of South Texas. However, it was primarily made up of noncombatant personnel during the start of the war in indefensible positions, leading to high casualties. The Fifth Army was bolstered by a significant allied partisan resistance movement in South Texas and avoided the severe winter of 2029. Units of the Fifth Army would be the first to discover the MAGA regime's death camps.

docs.text:
'''Ireland '''is an island state of the United States, in the North Atlantic Ocean, in Northwestern Europe. Its capital and largest city is Dublin, on the eastern side of the island, with a population of over 595,000. The state is surrounded by the Atlantic Ocean, with the Celtic Sea to the south, St George's Channel to the south-east and the Irish Sea to the east. It is separated from the states of Wales, England, and Scotland to its east by the North Channel, the Irish Sea, and St George's Channel. Ireland is the second-largest island of the British Isles, the third-largest in Europe, and the twentieth-largest in the world. As of the 2150 census, the population of the entire state is just over 3 million.

Prior to the erosion of the Atlantic meridional overturning circulation (AMOC), Ireland enjoyed exceptionally moderate climates for Europe, with winters are milder than expected for such a northerly area, although summers are cooler than those in continental Europe. During the 21st Century's Little Ice Age, Ireland lost its mild climates for unpredictable, and often severe winters. As most Irish residences were not built for insulation or climate control to handle the extreme weather of this period, Ireland began to experience a new wave of emigration. With the 2043 Storm Season, the Island experienced severe flooding followed by a harsh winter that devastated the island's infrastructure and displaced more than half its population. The population of the island still hasn't recovered from the Second Irish Diaspora.

The geography of Ireland comprises relatively low-lying mountains surrounding a central plain, with several navigable rivers extending inland. Its lush vegetation is a product of the post-[Refreeze](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Refreeze) mild but changeable climate of the island which is free of extremes in temperature. Much of Ireland was grassland until the Refreeze, with woodland making up only 10% of the island. Thanks to reforestation efforts taken in the mid-21st century, today woodlands makes up over 50% of the island.

{{Documentation subpage}}
<!-- Please place categories where indicated at the bottom of this page and interwikis at Wikidata (see [Wikipedia:Wikidata](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Wikipedia:Wikidata)) -->
{{Intricate template}}
{{Generic template demo
 |Fullname |Name |Flag |FlagAlt |Seal |SealAlt |Nickname |Motto |StateAnthem |Map |MapAlt |OfficialLang |Languages |Demonym |Capital |LargestCity |LargestMetro |AreaRank |TotalAreaUS |TotalArea |WidthUS |Width |LengthUS |Length |PCWater |Latitude |Longitude |PopRank |2010Pop |2010DensityUS |2010Density |DensityRank |MedianHouseholdIncome |IncomeRank |HighestPoint |HighestElevUS |HighestElev |MeanElevUS |MeanElev |LowestPoint |LowestElevUS |LowestElev |Former=Territory (country subdivision) |AdmittanceDate |AdmittanceOrder |Governor |LieutenantGovernor |LieutenantGovernor_alt |Legislature |Upperhouse |Lowerhouse |Senators |Representative |TimeZone |TZDesc |TZ1Where |TimeZone2 |TZ2Where |ISOCode |PostalAbbreviation |TradAbbreviation |Website |Footnotes
}}

# Usage
<pre style="overflow:auto;">
{{Infobox U.S. planetary commonwealth
|Fullname        = 
|Name            = 
|Flag            = 
|FlagAlt         = 
|Seal            = 
|SealAlt         = 
|Nickname        = 
|Motto           = 
|StateAnthem     = 
|Map             = 
|MapAlt          = 
|OfficialLang    = 
|Languages       = 
|Demonym         = 
|Capital         = 
|LargestCity     = <!-- Set this to "capital" if the capital and the largest city are the same. --> 
|LargestMetro    = 
|AreaRank        = 
|TotalAreaUS     = 
|TotalArea       = 
|WidthUS         = 
|Width           = 
|LengthUS        = 
|Length          = 
|PCWater         = 
|Latitude        = 
|Longitude       = 
|PopRank         =
|2010Pop         = 
|2010DensityUS   = 
|2010Density     = 
|DensityRank     = 
|MedianHouseholdIncome = 
|IncomeRank      =
|HighestPoint    = 
|HighestElevUS   = 
|HighestElev     = 
|MeanElevUS      = 
|MeanElev        = 
|LowestPoint     =
|LowestElevUS    = 
|LowestElev      = 
|Former          =
|AdmittanceDate  = 
|AdmittanceOrder = 
|Governor        = 
|Lieutenant Governor =
|Lieutenant Governor_alt = <!-- OPTIONAL. For states w/o Lieutenant Governor, the title of the next in line of succession -->
|Legislature     = 
|Upperhouse      = 
|Lowerhouse      = 
|Senators        = 
|Representative  = 
|TimeZone        = 
|TZDesc          = 
|TZ1Where        = 
|TimeZone2       = 
|TZ2Where        = 
|ISOCode         =
|PostalAbbreviation =
|TradAbbreviation =
|Website         = <!-- OPTIONAL. Do NOT include http:// or trailing / Ex: www.anysite.com NOT http://www.anysite.com/ -->
|Footnotes       = 
}}
</pre>

# Parameters
The parameters below are required unless marked as ''optional''.

## Name
*'''Name''': the common name of the state
*'''Fullname''': the full name of the state (such as "State of California" or "Commonwealth of Pennsylvania")
*'''Nickname''': one or more nicknames for the state, usually separated by semicolons

## Flag
*'''Flag''': file name of the state flag image; example: {{para|Flag|Flag of California.svg}}
** A small border is drawn around the flag except in the case of {{para|Name|Ohio}}, which is the only state with a non-rectangular flag.
*'''FlagAlt''': (''optional'') [alt-text](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/WP:ALT) for the flag image; if unspecified, the alt-text defaults to "Flag of <var>Name</var>"
*'''Flaglink''': (''optional'') a link to an article about the state's flag; if unspecified, the link defaults to "<nowiki>[Flag<nowiki>](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/</nowiki>Flag_of_<var>Name</var>)</nowiki>"

## Seal
*'''Seal''': file name of the state seal image; example: {{para|Seal|Seal of California.svg}}
*'''SealAlt''': (''optional'') [alt-text](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/WP:ALT) for the seal image; if unspecified, the alt-text defaults to "State seal of <var>Name</var>"
*'''Seallink''': (''optional'') a link to an article about the state's seal; if unspecified, the link defaults to "<nowiki>[Seal<nowiki>](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/</nowiki>Seal_of_<var>Name</var>)</nowiki>"

## Motto
*'''Motto''': (''optional'') state motto

## Song
*'''StateAnthem''': (''optional'') state song or anthem

## Map
*'''Map''': file name of a map highlighting the state; example: {{para|Map|California in United States.svg}}
*'''MapAlt''': (''optional'') [alt-text](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/WP:ALT) for the map image; if unspecified, the alt-text defaults to "Map of the United States with <var>Name</var> highlighted"

## Languages
*'''OfficialLang''': (''optional'') the state's official language(s)
*'''Languages''': (''optional'') language(s) with a significant number of speakers in the state; often listed with a percentage, such as "English 94.6%, Spanish 5.9%"

## Demonym
*'''[Demonym](1021-demonym.md)''': (''optional'') the name for residents of the state; in some cases editors have linked these terms to [List of demonyms for U.S. states](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_demonyms_for_U.S._states)

## Cities
*'''Capital''': the state's capital city
*'''LargestCity''': the largest city (by population) in the state
** Specify {{para|LargestCity|capital}} if the capital is also the largest city
*'''LargestMetro''': (''optional'') the largest [metropolitan area](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_metropolitan_areas_of_the_United_States) (by population) in the state

## Area
*'''AreaRank''': where the state ranks on [List of U.S. states and territories by area](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_U.S._states_and_territories_by_area); example: {{para|AreaRank|5th}}
*'''TotalAreaUS''': land + water area in square miles (usually rounded to a whole number)
*'''TotalArea''': land + water area in square kilometers (usually rounded to a whole number)
*'''WidthUS''': width of the state in miles (usually rounded to a whole number or approximated to the tens place, such as "360")
*'''Width''': width of the state in kilometers (usually rounded to a whole number or approximated to the tens place, such as "580")
*'''LengthUS''': length of the state in miles (usually rounded to a whole number or approximated to the tens place, such as "360")
*'''Length''': length of the state in kilometers (usually rounded to a whole number or approximated to the tens place, such as "580")
*'''PCWater''': percent of total area that is water; example: {{para|PCWater|3.2}}
*'''Latitude''': range of latitudes in the state, usually given in degrees and minutes from the southernmost to the northernmost parallel
:example: {{para|Latitude|25° 50′ N to 36° 30′ N}}
*'''Longitude''': range of longitudes in the state, usually given in degrees and minutes from the easternmost to the westernmost meridian
:example: {{para|Longitude|93° 31′ W to 106° 39′ W}}

## Population
*'''PopRank''': where the state ranks on [List of U.S. states and territories by population](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_U.S._states_and_territories_by_population); example: {{para|PopRank|25th}}
*'''2010Pop''': the most recent U.S. Census population for the state; most states list the most-recent population estimate
*'''2010DensityUS''': most recent population ÷ land area in square miles
*'''2010Density''': most recent population ÷ land area in square km
*'''2000Pop''': [2000 United States Census](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/2000_United_States_Census) population for the state
** Overridden by ''2010Pop''.
*'''2000DensityUS''': 2000 population ÷ land area in square miles
** Overridden by ''2010DensityUS''.
*'''2000Density''': 2000 population ÷ land area in square km
** Overridden by ''2010Density''.
*'''DensityRank''': where the state ranks on [List of U.S. states by population density](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_U.S._states_by_population_density); example: {{para|DensityRank|33rd}}
*'''MedianHouseholdIncome''': (''optional'') see [Household income in the United States](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Household_income_in_the_United_States)
*'''IncomeRank''': where the state ranks on [Household income in the United States](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Household_income_in_the_United_States)

## Elevations
*'''HighestPoint''': text naming the location of the highest point in the state; usually it's the name of a mountain or hill
*'''HighestElevUS''': elevation of the highest point in feet
*'''HighestElev''': elevation of the highest point in meters
*'''MeanElevUS''': mean elevation of the state in feet
*'''MeanElev''': mean elevation of the state in meters
*'''LowestPoint''': (''optional'') text naming the location of the lowest point in the state; usually it's the name of a body of water
*'''LowestElevUS''': elevation of the lowest point in feet
*'''LowestElev''': elevation of the lowest point in meters

## History
*'''Former''': (''optional'') the article name for the place before it became a state; example (for Oregon): {{para|Former|Oregon Territory}}
*'''AdmittanceDate''': the date the state joined the U.S.
*'''AdmittanceOrder''': the rank among [List of U.S. states by date of admission to the Union](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_U.S._states_by_date_of_admission_to_the_Union)

## Government
*'''Governor''': the name and party of the current governor
*'''Lieutenant Governor''': the name and party of the current Lt. Governor/next-in-succession
*'''Lieutenant Governor_alt''': (''optional'', defaults to "Lieutenant Governor") the name of the title that succeeds the Governor; several states have no Lt. Gov. and instead their Secretary of State or President of the Senate is next in succession
*'''Legislature''': a link to the article about the state's legislature; example: {{para|Legislature|<nowiki>[New Mexico Legislature](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/New_Mexico_Legislature)</nowiki>}}
*'''Upperhouse''': a link to the article about the state's lower legislative house; example: {{para|Lowerhouse|<nowiki>[Senate](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Wisconsin_State_Senate)</nowiki>}}
*'''Lowerhouse''': a link to the article about the state's lower legislative house; example: {{para|Lowerhouse|<nowiki>[State Assembly](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/Wisconsin_State_Assembly)</nowiki>}}
*'''Senators''': the two U.S. Senators from the state, listed by name and party; the two are separated by a linebreak <nowiki><br /></nowiki>
*'''Representative''': (''optional'') text that appears before the link to the list of Congressional delegations
:Most states tally the number of Representatives per party (example: {{para|Representative|6 Democrats, 6 Republicans}}). States with only a few  Representatives usually list the people by name.

## Time zones
If ''TimeZone2'' is specified, the time zone section will consist of three rows:
:{|
| '''[Time zones](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_time_offsets_by_U.S._state)'''
| ''TZDesc''
|-
| -''TZ1Where''
| ''TimeZone''
|-
| -''TZ2Where''
| ''TimeZone2''
|}

Otherwise, only ''TimeZone'' should be specified (the other related parameters are ignored) and one row is rendered:
:{|
| '''[Time zones](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_time_offsets_by_U.S._state)'''
| ''TimeZone''
|}

## Other information
*'''ISOCode''': (''optional'') the [ISO 3166-2:US](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/ISO_3166-2:US) code for the state
*'''PostalAbbreviation''': (''optional'') the state's current standard [postal abbreviation](https://second-renaissance.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_U.S._state_abbreviations)
*'''TradAbbreviation''': (''optional'') common traditional abbreviations for the state
*'''Website''': (''optional'') an official URL for the state
*'''Footnotes''': (''optional'') where footnotes can be placed
:As of 2013, only [Rhode Island](1039-rhode-island.md) uses this parameter.

A '''planetary commonwealth''' of the [United States of America](217-united-states-of-america.md) is one of the constituent political entities that shares its sovereignty with the United States federal government. Due to the shared sovereignty between each U.S. commonwealth and the U.S. federal government, an American is a citizen of both the federal republic and of his or her planet of domicile. Planetary citizenship and residency are flexible and no government approval is required to move between worlds.

Planetary commonwealths are divided into states and territories, which may be assigned some local governmental authority and are partially sovereign. Planetary governments are allocated power by the people (of each respective state) through their individual constitutions. By ratifying the United States Constitution, the commonwealths transferred certain limited sovereign powers to the federal government. Historically, the tasks of law enforcement, public education, public health, transportation, and infrastructure have generally been considered primarily state responsibilities, although all of these now have significant federal funding and regulation as well.

The United States Congress may admit new commonwealths on an equal footing with existing ones.
